theorem Iceberg.iceberg_root
  ∀ (w a m : Iceberg.Tub) (pw : Iceberg.Process w) (pa : Iceberg.Process a) (pm : Iceberg.Process m)
    (epsilon metalDensity : Iceberg.Q),
    w.rho * pw.finalInclusionVolume = w.inclusionMass →
      pa.finalInclusionVolume = 0 →
        0 ≤ epsilon →
          a.inclusionMass ≤ a.rho * a.area * epsilon →
            m.rho < metalDensity →
              0 < pm.finalInclusionVolume →
                metalDensity * pm.finalInclusionVolume = m.inclusionMass →
                  pw.finalHeight = w.rim ∧
                    Iceberg.Within a.rim pa.finalHeight epsilon ∧
                      pa.finalHeight ≤ a.rim ∧
                        pm.finalHeight < m.rim ∧
                          Iceberg.spilled w (pw.finalStage :: pw.history) = 0 ∧
                            Iceberg.spilled a (pa.finalStage :: pa.history) = 0 ∧
                              Iceberg.spilled m (pm.finalStage :: pm.history) = 0

theorem Iceberg.residual_height_bound
  ∀ (rho area before after volume mass residual epsilon : Iceberg.Q),
    0 < rho →
      0 < area →
        rho * area * (after - before) = rho * volume - mass + residual →
          -(rho * area * epsilon) ≤ rho * volume - mass + residual →
            rho * volume - mass + residual ≤ rho * area * epsilon → Iceberg.Within before after epsilon

theorem VE.Alternatives.allowsF_denote

  ∀ (A : VE.Alternatives.AltDoc),
    VE.Alternatives.WellFormedAlt A = Bool.true →

        ∀ (c : VE.Tableau.Certificate),
          VE.Tableau.checkCertificate (VE.Norms.envAt (VE.Alternatives.inlineTree A) 0)

theorem VE.Closure.Surface.parseRaw_print_named
  ∀ (E : VE.Environment),
    VE.Surface.NamesValid E →
      ∀ (Γ names : List String) (next : Nat),
        VE.Surface.Scope names next →
          names.length = Γ.length →
            ∀ (k : VE.Closure.Kind) (p : String) (t u : VE.Term),
              VE.Closure.Formula.WellFormed E Γ (VE.Closure.Formula.reachNamed k p t u) →
                ∀ (fuel : Nat) (tail : List Char),
                  VE.Closure.Surface.parseRaw E (fuel + 1) names
                      ((VE.Closure.Surface.printAux names next (VE.Closure.Formula.reachNamed k p t u)).fst ++ tail) =
                    Option.some (VE.Closure.Formula.reachNamed k p t u, tail)
  -- uses VE.Closure.Formula.WellFormed@VE.Closure.Syntax VE.Closure.Formula.reachNamed@VE.Closure.Syntax VE.Closure.Formula@VE.Closure.Syntax VE.Closure.Kind@VE.Closure.Paths VE.Closure.Surface.parseRaw@VE.Closure.Surface VE.Closure.Surface.printAux@VE.Closure.Surface VE.Environment@VE.Syntax VE.Surface.NamesValid@VE.Surface VE.Surface.Scope@VE.RoundTrip VE.Term@VE.Syntax
  -- expr 1776161558
theorem VE.Closure.Surface.parseStatements_nonempty
  ∀ (E : VE.Environment) (fuel : Nat) (input : List Char),
    input ≠ [] →
      VE.Closure.Surface.parseStatements E (fuel + 1) input = do
        let __discr ← VE.Closure.Surface.parseRaw E (input.length + 1) [] input
        match __discr with
          | (a, rest) => do
            let rest ← VE.Surface.consume ['.', '\n'] rest
            let tail ← VE.Closure.Surface.parseStatements E fuel rest
            Option.some (a :: tail)
  -- uses VE.Closure.Formula@VE.Closure.Syntax VE.Closure.Surface.parseRaw@VE.Closure.Surface VE.Closure.Surface.parseStatements@VE.Closure.Surface VE.Closure.Surface.parseStatements_nonempty.match_1@VE.Closure.RoundTrip VE.Environment@VE.Syntax VE.Surface.consume@VE.Surface

theorem VE.Core.Surface.parseRaw_print_named
  ∀ (E : VE.Environment),
    VE.Surface.NamesValid E →
      ∀ (Γ names : List String) (next : Nat),
        VE.Surface.Scope names next →
          names.length = Γ.length →
            ∀ (k : VE.Core.Kind) (p : String) (t u : VE.Term),
              VE.Core.Formula.WellFormed E Γ (VE.Core.Formula.reachNamed k p t u) →
                ∀ (fuel : Nat) (tail : List Char),
                  VE.Core.Surface.parseRaw E (fuel + 1) names
                      ((VE.Core.Surface.printAux names next (VE.Core.Formula.reachNamed k p t u)).fst ++ tail) =
                    Option.some (VE.Core.Formula.reachNamed k p t u, tail)
  -- uses VE.Core.Formula.WellFormed@VE.Core.Syntax VE.Core.Formula.reachNamed@VE.Core.Syntax VE.Core.Formula@VE.Core.Syntax VE.Core.Kind@VE.Core.Paths VE.Core.Surface.parseRaw@VE.Core.Surface VE.Core.Surface.printAux@VE.Core.Surface VE.Environment@VE.Syntax VE.Surface.NamesValid@VE.Surface VE.Surface.Scope@VE.RoundTrip VE.Term@VE.Syntax
  -- expr 2511736457
theorem VE.Core.Surface.parseStatements_nonempty
  ∀ (E : VE.Environment) (fuel : Nat) (input : List Char),
    input ≠ [] →
      VE.Core.Surface.parseStatements E (fuel + 1) input = do
        let __discr ← VE.Core.Surface.parseRaw E (input.length + 1) [] input
        match __discr with
          | (a, rest) => do
            let rest ← VE.Surface.consume ['.', '\n'] rest
            let tail ← VE.Core.Surface.parseStatements E fuel rest
            Option.some (a :: tail)
  -- uses VE.Core.Formula@VE.Core.Syntax VE.Core.Surface.parseRaw@VE.Core.Surface VE.Core.Surface.parseStatements@VE.Core.Surface VE.Core.Surface.parseStatements_nonempty.match_1@VE.Core.RoundTrip VE.Environment@VE.Syntax VE.Surface.consume@VE.Surface
  -- expr 1836030701

theorem VE.Core.Tableau.delta_witness
  ∀ (S : VE.Structure) (ρ : VE.Core.Tableau.Assignment S) (a : VE.Core.Tableau.Signed) (s : String) (f : VE.Core.Formula),
    a.rule = VE.Core.Tableau.Rule.delta s f →
      VE.Core.Tableau.Signed.Holds S ρ a →
        ∃ v,
          S.domain s v ∧
            if a.positive = Bool.true then VE.Core.Formula.denote S (v :: VE.Core.Tableau.bindingsValue S ρ a.bindings) f
            else ¬VE.Core.Formula.denote S (v :: VE.Core.Tableau.bindingsValue S ρ a.bindings) f

theorem VE.Core.Wire.run_certificate_acceptance
  ∀ (profiles : List String) (environment : Lean.Json) (id : String)
    (j result premisesJson conclusionJson certificateJson : Lean.Json) (premiseArray : Array Lean.Json)
    (v : VE.Bridge.Vocabulary) (ps : List VE.Core.Formula) (c : VE.Core.Formula)
    (certificate : VE.Core.Tableau.Certificate),
    VE.Core.Bridge.decodeEnvironment environment = Except.ok v →
      j.getObjVal? "premises" = Except.ok premisesJson →
        premisesJson.getArr? = Except.ok premiseArray →
          VE.Core.Bridge.decodeFormulas v.environment premisesJson = Except.ok ps →
            j.getObjVal? "conclusion" = Except.ok conclusionJson →
              VE.Core.Bridge.decodeFormula 64 conclusionJson = Except.ok c →
                VE.Core.Bridge.checkFormula v.environment c "conclusion" = Except.ok () →
                  j.getObjVal? "certificate" = Except.ok certificateJson →
                    VE.Core.Wire.decodeCertificate certificateJson = Except.ok certificate →
                      VE.Core.Wire.run profiles environment id "certificate" j = Except.ok result →
                        result.getObjVal? "valid" = Except.ok (Lean.Json.bool Bool.true) →
                          VE.Route.Wire.bindingOk profiles environment
                                (List.map VE.Route.Wire.encodeFormula
                                    (VE.Route.Background.literals (VE.Core.Wire.literals v)) ++
                                  premiseArray.toList)
                                conclusionJson certificate.environment_id certificate.premise_meaning_ids
                                certificate.conclusion_meaning_id =
                              Except.ok () ∧
                            ∀ (S : VE.Structure),
                              S.Admissible v.environment →
                                (∀ (b : VE.Formula),
                                    b ∈ VE.Route.Background.literals (VE.Core.Wire.literals v) →
                                      VE.Formula.denote S [] b) →
                                  (∀ (p : VE.Core.Formula), p ∈ ps → VE.Core.Formula.denote S [] p) →
                                    VE.Core.Formula.denote S [] c
  -- uses VE.Bridge.Vocabulary.environment@VE.Bridge VE.Bridge.Vocabulary@VE.Bridge VE.Core.Bridge.checkFormula@VE.Core.Bridge VE.Core.Bridge.decodeEnvironment@VE.Core.Bridge VE.Core.Bridge.decodeFormula@VE.Core.Bridge VE.Core.Bridge.decodeFormulas@VE.Core.Bridge VE.Core.Formula.denote@VE.Core.Syntax VE.Core.Formula@VE.Core.Syntax VE.Core.Tableau.Certificate.conclusion_meaning_id@VE.Core.TableauExtended VE.Core.Tableau.Certificate.environment_id@VE.Core.TableauExtended VE.Core.Tableau.Certificate.premise_meaning_ids@VE.Core.TableauExtended VE.Core.Tableau.Certificate@VE.Core.TableauExtended VE.Core.Wire.decodeCertificate@VE.Core.Wire VE.Core.Wire.literals@VE.Core.Wire VE.Core.Wire.run@VE.Core.Wire VE.Formula.denote@VE.Semantics VE.Formula@VE.Syntax VE.Route.Background.literals@VE.Route.Background VE.Route.Wire.bindingOk@VE.Route.Wire VE.Route.Wire.encodeFormula@VE.Route.Wire VE.Structure.Admissible@VE.Semantics VE.Structure.Carrier@VE.Semantics VE.Structure@VE.Semantics
  -- expr 221721523

theorem VE.Definitions.Alias.alias_acceptance
  ∀ (E : VE.Environment) (p q s : String),
    s ∈ E.sorts →
      E.predicates p = Option.none →
        E.predicates q = Option.some [s] →
          q ≠ p →
            ∀ (Γ : List VE.Formula) (φ : VE.Formula),
              (∀ (a : VE.Formula), a ∈ Γ → VE.Formula.WellFormed E [] a) →
                VE.Formula.WellFormed E [] φ →
                  ∀ (c : VE.Tableau.Certificate),
                    VE.Tableau.checkCertificate (VE.Route.Examples.extend E p s) (VE.Definitions.Alias.expand p q s ++ Γ)
                          φ c =
                        Bool.true →
                      VE.Entails E Γ φ
  -- uses VE.Definitions.Alias.expand@VE.Definitions.Alias VE.Entails@VE.Semantics VE.Environment.predicates@VE.Syntax VE.Environment.sorts@VE.Syntax VE.Environment@VE.Syntax VE.Formula.WellFormed@VE.Syntax VE.Formula@VE.Syntax VE.Route.Examples.extend@VE.Route.Examples VE.Tableau.Certificate@VE.Tableau VE.Tableau.checkCertificate@VE.TableauChecker
  -- expr 4072046837
theorem VE.Definitions.Alias.conservative
  ∀ (E : VE.Environment) (p q s : String),
    E.predicates p = Option.none →
      q ≠ p →
        ∀ (S₀ : VE.Structure),
          S₀.Admissible E →
            VE.Route.Unique fun S =>
              VE.Route.Examples.forget p S = S₀ ∧
                S.Admissible (VE.Route.Examples.extend E p s) ∧
                  ∀ (a : VE.Formula), a ∈ VE.Definitions.Alias.expand p q s → VE.Formula.denote S [] a
  -- uses VE.Definitions.Alias.expand@VE.Definitions.Alias VE.Environment.predicates@VE.Syntax VE.Environment@VE.Syntax VE.Formula.denote@VE.Semantics VE.Formula@VE.Syntax VE.Route.Examples.extend@VE.Route.Examples VE.Route.Examples.forget@VE.Route.Examples VE.Route.Unique@VE.Route.Layer VE.Structure.Admissible@VE.Semantics VE.Structure.Carrier@VE.Semantics VE.Structure@VE.Semantics
  -- expr 3143445088
theorem VE.Definitions.Alias.faithful
  ∀ (p q s : String) (S : VE.Structure),
    (∀ (a : VE.Formula), a ∈ VE.Definitions.Alias.expand p q s → VE.Formula.denote S [] a) ↔

theorem VE.Definitions.Bundle.bundle_sound
  ∀ (E : VE.Environment) (ds : List VE.Definitions.Def),
    VE.Definitions.Chain E ds →
      ∀ (lits : List String),
        lits.Nodup →
          ∀ (sets : List VE.Route.Admission.ReadingSet)
            (bind : List VE.Formula → VE.Formula → VE.Tableau.Certificate → Except String Unit)
            (Ls : List VE.Definitions.Bundle.Lemma) (res : List VE.Definitions.Bundle.Known),
            VE.Definitions.Bundle.checkAll E (VE.Definitions.Bundle.backgroundLeaves ds lits) sets bind [] Ls =

                  k ∈ res →
                    VE.Definitions.Bundle.ReadingCompatible k.leaves ∧ VE.Definitions.Bundle.ReadingBound sets k.leaves) ∧
                ∀ (k : VE.Definitions.Bundle.Known),
                  k ∈ res →

                      VE.Definitions.Intended E ds lits S →
                        (∀ (l : VE.Definitions.Bundle.Leaf),
                            l ∈ k.leaves →
                              ¬l ∈ VE.Definitions.Bundle.backgroundLeaves ds lits → VE.Formula.denote S [] l.snd) →
                          VE.Formula.denote S [] k.conclusion

theorem VE.Definitions.acceptance
  ∀ (E : VE.Environment) (ds : List VE.Definitions.Def),
    VE.Definitions.Chain E ds →
      ∀ (lits : List String),
        lits.Nodup →
          ∀ (Γ : List VE.Formula) (φ : VE.Formula) (c : VE.Tableau.Certificate),
            VE.Tableau.checkCertificate E (VE.Definitions.background ds lits ++ Γ) φ c = Bool.true →
              VE.Entails E (VE.Definitions.background ds lits ++ Γ) φ ∧
                (∀ (S : VE.Structure),
                    VE.Definitions.Intended E ds lits S →
                      (∀ (a : VE.Formula), a ∈ Γ → VE.Formula.denote S [] a) → VE.Formula.denote S [] φ) ∧
                  ((∀ (a : VE.Formula),
                        a ∈ Γ → VE.Formula.WellFormed (VE.Definitions.hide E (VE.Definitions.names ds)) [] a) →
                      VE.Formula.WellFormed (VE.Definitions.hide E (VE.Definitions.names ds)) [] φ →
                        ∀ (S₀ : VE.Structure),
                          VE.Route.Background.StringAdmissible (VE.Definitions.hide E (VE.Definitions.names ds)) lits S₀ →
                            (∀ (a : VE.Formula), a ∈ Γ → VE.Formula.denote S₀ [] a) → VE.Formula.denote S₀ [] φ) ∧
                    ∀ (S₀ : VE.Structure),
                      VE.Route.Background.StringAdmissible (VE.Definitions.hide E (VE.Definitions.names ds)) lits S₀ →
                        ∃ S,
                          VE.Definitions.forget (VE.Definitions.names ds) S = S₀ ∧
                            VE.Definitions.Intended E ds lits S ∧
                              ((∀ (a : VE.Formula), a ∈ Γ → VE.Formula.denote S [] a) → VE.Formula.denote S [] φ)
  -- uses VE.Definitions.Chain@VE.Definitions.Layer VE.Definitions.Def@VE.Definitions.Layer VE.Definitions.Intended@VE.Definitions.Route VE.Definitions.background@VE.Definitions.Route VE.Definitions.forget@VE.Definitions.Layer VE.Definitions.hide@VE.Definitions.Layer VE.Definitions.names@VE.Definitions.Layer VE.Entails@VE.Semantics VE.Environment@VE.Syntax VE.Formula.WellFormed@VE.Syntax VE.Formula.denote@VE.Semantics VE.Formula@VE.Syntax VE.Route.Background.StringAdmissible@VE.Route.Background VE.Structure.Carrier@VE.Semantics VE.Structure@VE.Semantics VE.Tableau.Certificate@VE.Tableau VE.Tableau.checkCertificate@VE.TableauChecker
  -- expr 3225267748

theorem VE.Definitions.conservative
  ∀ (E : VE.Environment) (ds : List VE.Definitions.Def),
    VE.Definitions.Chain E ds →
      ∀ (X : VE.Structure → Prop),
        VE.Definitions.RelationFree X →
          ∀ (S₀ : VE.Structure),
            S₀.Admissible (VE.Definitions.hide E (VE.Definitions.names ds)) →

theorem VE.Definitions.conservative_entails
  ∀ (E : VE.Environment) (ds : List VE.Definitions.Def),
    VE.Definitions.Chain E ds →
      ∀ (X : VE.Structure → Prop),
        VE.Definitions.RelationFree X →
          ∀ (Γ : List VE.Formula) (φ : VE.Formula),
            (∀ (a : VE.Formula), a ∈ Γ → VE.Formula.WellFormed (VE.Definitions.hide E (VE.Definitions.names ds)) [] a) →
              VE.Formula.WellFormed (VE.Definitions.hide E (VE.Definitions.names ds)) [] φ →
                ((∀ (S : VE.Structure),
                    S.Admissible E →
                      X S →
                        (∀ (a : VE.Formula), a ∈ VE.Definitions.expand ds ++ Γ → VE.Formula.denote S [] a) →

                    S₀.Admissible (VE.Definitions.hide E (VE.Definitions.names ds)) →
                      X S₀ → (∀ (a : VE.Formula), a ∈ Γ → VE.Formula.denote S₀ [] a) → VE.Formula.denote S₀ [] φ)
  -- uses VE.Definitions.Chain@VE.Definitions.Layer VE.Definitions.Def@VE.Definitions.Layer VE.Definitions.RelationFree@VE.Definitions.Layer VE.Definitions.expand@VE.Definitions.Layer VE.Definitions.hide@VE.Definitions.Layer VE.Definitions.names@VE.Definitions.Layer VE.Environment@VE.Syntax VE.Formula.WellFormed@VE.Syntax VE.Formula.denote@VE.Semantics VE.Formula@VE.Syntax VE.Structure.Admissible@VE.Semantics VE.Structure.Carrier@VE.Semantics VE.Structure@VE.Semantics

theorem VE.Discourse.Admit2Facts.bound
  ∀ {profiles : List String} {environment : Lean.Json} {rv : VE.Route.Wire.RouteVocabulary} {j : Lean.Json}
    {check : ByteArray → VE.Discourse.ImportOutcome} {res : VE.Discourse.Admitted},
    VE.Discourse.Admit2Facts profiles environment rv j check res →
      ∀ (u : String),
        res.bound u ≠ Option.none →
          (List.map Prod.fst res.pending).contains u = Bool.false ∧
            res.bound u =

theorem VE.Discourse.assertive_denote

    {envId : String},

      (∀ (u : String),

                      ∃ mid,
                        VE.Route.Wire.meaningId bp envId (VE.Route.Wire.encodeFormula A) = Except.ok mid ∧

theorem VE.Discourse.carrier_cases
  ∀ (D : VE.Discourse.DDoc) (wires : List VE.Route.Admission.WireNode) (doc : VE.Route.Admission.Doc)
    (premises : List String) (m : VE.Discourse.Mention) (Dr : VE.Formula),
    m.restriction = Option.some Dr →
      ∀ (σ : String),
        VE.Discourse.restrictionSort D m = Option.some σ →
          (∃ n w,
              VE.Discourse.carrierIn D wires doc premises m = Option.some (VE.Discourse.PresuppositionCarrier.proved n) ∧
                w ∈ wires ∧
                  w.claim.name = n ∧
                    w.unit = Option.none ∧
                      w.deduction.isSome = Bool.true ∧
                        w.claim.label = "asserted" ∧ w.claim.formula = VE.Discourse.uniqueD σ Dr) ∨
            (∃ u,
                VE.Discourse.carrierIn D wires doc premises m =
                    Option.some (VE.Discourse.PresuppositionCarrier.assumed u) ∧
                  m.presuppositionUnit = Option.some u ∧
                    VE.Route.Admission.AssertedUnit doc u (VE.Discourse.uniqueD σ Dr) ∧ u ∈ premises) ∨
              VE.Discourse.carrierIn D wires doc premises m = Option.none
  -- uses VE.Discourse.DDoc@VE.Discourse.Manifest VE.Discourse.Mention.presuppositionUnit@VE.Discourse.Manifest VE.Discourse.Mention.restriction@VE.Discourse.Manifest VE.Discourse.Mention@VE.Discourse.Manifest VE.Discourse.PresuppositionCarrier.assumed@VE.Discourse.Descriptions VE.Discourse.PresuppositionCarrier.proved@VE.Discourse.Descriptions VE.Discourse.PresuppositionCarrier@VE.Discourse.Descriptions VE.Discourse.carrierIn@VE.Discourse.Admission VE.Discourse.restrictionSort@VE.Discourse.WellFormed VE.Discourse.uniqueD@VE.Discourse.Descriptions VE.Formula@VE.Syntax VE.Graph.Claim.formula@VE.ClaimGraph VE.Graph.Claim.label@VE.ClaimGraph VE.Graph.Claim.name@VE.ClaimGraph VE.Graph.Edge@VE.ClaimGraph VE.Route.Admission.AssertedUnit@VE.Route.Admission VE.Route.Admission.Doc@VE.Route.Admission VE.Route.Admission.WireNode.claim@VE.Route.Admission VE.Route.Admission.WireNode.deduction@VE.Route.Admission VE.Route.Admission.WireNode.unit@VE.Route.Admission VE.Route.Admission.WireNode@VE.Route.Admission VE.Tableau.Certificate@VE.Tableau

theorem VE.Discourse.discourse_wire_binding
  ∀ (profiles : List String) (environment : Lean.Json) (rv : VE.Route.Wire.RouteVocabulary) (j : Lean.Json) (fuel : Nat)
    (res : VE.Discourse.Admitted),
    VE.Discourse.formatOf j = Option.some "ve-document@2" →
      VE.Discourse.admitDiscourse profiles environment rv j fuel = Except.ok res →
        res.doc.sourceId =
            VE.Discourse.Loader.sourceId (VE.Discourse.baseProfiles profiles) (VE.Discourse.Loader.sourceOf j) ∧
          (∃ K₀ K,
              VE.Discourse.Wire.decodeManifest res.doc.sets (VE.Discourse.Loader.filesOf j) res.environmentId
                    ((VE.Discourse.Loader.metaOf j).getObjValD "discourse") =
                  Except.ok K₀ ∧
                VE.Discourse.Wire.toTokenSpans { prose := VE.Discourse.Loader.sourceOf j } res.doc.base K₀ = Except.ok K ∧
                  res.doc.K =
                      { definitionsVersion := K.definitionsVersion, documentSort := K.documentSort, anchors := K.anchors,
                        names := K.names, contentNames := K.contentNames, mentions := K.mentions,
                        documents := K.documents, imports := K.imports, groups := K.groups, constraints := K.constraints,
                        validity := [], selfTruth := K.selfTruth, choices := K.choices } ∧
                    res.claims = K.validity) ∧
            VE.Route.Wire.environmentId (VE.Discourse.baseProfiles profiles) (VE.Discourse.baseEnvironment environment) =
                Except.ok res.environmentId ∧
              res.doc.K.definitionsVersion = res.environmentId ∧
                (∀ (u : String) (A : VE.Formula),
                    res.bound u = Option.some A →
                      ∃ mid,
                        VE.Route.Wire.meaningId (VE.Discourse.baseProfiles profiles) res.environmentId
                              (VE.Route.Wire.encodeFormula A) =
                            Except.ok mid ∧
                          VE.Discourse.boundMeaningId res u = Option.some mid) ∧
                  (∀ (w : VE.Route.Admission.WireNode),
                      w ∈ res.base.wires →
                        ∀ (edge : VE.Graph.Edge VE.Tableau.Certificate),
                          w.deduction = Option.some edge → edge.certificate.environment_id = res.environmentId) ∧
                    VE.Discourse.Loader.documentId j = Except.ok res.documentId ∧
                      VE.Discourse.wrapperReportId profiles res.environmentId res.documentId res.innerReportId
                          res.references (VE.Discourse.validityJsonOf res.claims res.validity) =
                        Except.ok res.reportId
  -- uses VE.Discourse.Admitted.base@VE.Discourse.Admission VE.Discourse.Admitted.bound@VE.Discourse.Admission VE.Discourse.Admitted.claims@VE.Discourse.Admission theorem VE.Discourse.group_single_assertion
  ∀ (profiles : List String) (environment : Lean.Json) (rv : VE.Route.Wire.RouteVocabulary) (j : Lean.Json) (fuel : Nat)
    (res : VE.Discourse.Admitted),
    VE.Discourse.admitDiscourse profiles environment rv j fuel = Except.ok res →
      ∀ (g : VE.Discourse.Group),
        g ∈ res.doc.K.groups →
          (∃ rs,
              rs ∈ res.base.doc.readingSets ∧
                rs.id = g.set ∧
                  rs.version = g.version ∧
                    ∃ φ, VE.Discourse.groupFormula res.doc g = Option.some φ ∧ rs.readings[g.reading]? = Option.some φ) ∧
            VE.Discourse.owningUnit res.doc g = g.spans.head? ∧
              (List.filter (fun l => Decidable.decide (VE.Discourse.setOfLabel l.label = Option.some (g.set, g.version)))
                      res.base.report.assumptions).length ≤
                  1 ∧
                (∀ (l : VE.Graph.Claim),
                    l ∈ res.base.report.assumptions →
                      l.label = "asserted" →
                        ∀ (u : String), u ∈ g.spans → VE.Discourse.unitOfLeaf res.base l ≠ Option.some u) ∧
                  ∀ (u : String),
                    u ∈ g.spans →
                      (VE.Discourse.unitOf res.base.doc u).bind VE.Route.Admission.DocUnit.content = Option.none ∧
                        res.bound u = Option.none ∧
                          ¬u ∈ res.premiseUnits ∧ VE.Discourse.statusOf res u = VE.Discourse.statusOf res g.spans.head!
  -- uses VE.Discourse.Admitted.base@VE.Discourse.Admission VE.Discourse.Admitted.bound@VE.Discourse.Admission VE.Discourse.Admitted.doc@VE.Discourse.Admission VE.Discourse.Admitted.premiseUnits@VE.Discourse.Admission VE.Discourse.Admitted@VE.Discourse.Admission VE.Discourse.DDoc.K@VE.Discourse.Manifest VE.Discourse.Group.reading@VE.Discourse.Manifest VE.Discourse.Group.set@VE.Discourse.Manifest VE.Discourse.Group.spans@VE.Discourse.Manifest VE.Discourse.Group.version@VE.Discourse.Manifest VE.Discourse.Group@VE.Discourse.Manifest VE.Discourse.Manifest.groups@VE.Discourse.Manifest VE.Discourse.admitDiscourse@VE.Discourse.Admission VE.Discourse.groupFormula@VE.Discourse.WellFormed VE.Discourse.owningUnit@VE.Discourse.WellFormed VE.Discourse.setOfLabel@VE.Discourse.Admission VE.Discourse.statusOf@VE.Discourse.Admission VE.Discourse.unitOf@VE.Discourse.Manifest VE.Discourse.unitOfLeaf@VE.Discourse.Admission VE.Formula@VE.Syntax VE.Graph.Claim.label@VE.ClaimGraph VE.Graph.Claim@VE.ClaimGraph VE.Graph.Report.assumptions@VE.ClaimGraph VE.Route.Admission.Admitted.doc@VE.Route.Admission VE.Route.Admission.Admitted.report@VE.Route.Admission VE.Route.Admission.Doc.readingSets@VE.Route.Admission VE.Route.Admission.DocUnit.content@VE.Route.Admission VE.Route.Admission.DocUnit@VE.Route.Admission VE.Route.Admission.ReadingSet.id@VE.Route.Admission VE.Route.Admission.ReadingSet.readings@VE.Route.Admission VE.Route.Admission.ReadingSet.version@VE.Route.Admission VE.Route.Admission.ReadingSet@VE.Route.Admission VE.Route.Wire.RouteVocabulary@VE.Route.Wire

theorem VE.Discourse.ill_typed_found
  ∀ (D : VE.Discourse.DDoc) (u : String) (s : List VE.English.Tok),
    D.text u = Option.some s →
      D.K.mentions.length ≤ VE.Discourse.mentionLimit →
        ∀ (d : VE.Discourse.DTree) (σ : VE.Discourse.Assignment),
          VE.Discourse.Derives D u s d →
            (∀ (m : VE.Discourse.Slot),
                m ∈ d.slots → VE.Discourse.Acc D m (σ m) ∧ VE.Discourse.recordedTarget D m = Option.some (σ m)) →
              ∀ (m : VE.Discourse.Slot),
                m ∈ d.slots →
                  ∀ (A : VE.Formula),
                    VE.Discourse.elaborateD D d σ = Option.some A →
                      VE.Formula.check D.E [] A = Bool.false →
                        ∃ d'',
                          d'' ∈ VE.Discourse.derivs D u s ∧
                            VE.Discourse.illTypedOf D d'' = Bool.true ∧
                              VE.Discourse.validate D u = Except.error (VE.Discourse.illTypedText D u d'')

theorem VE.Discourse.independent_shortcut
  ∀ (E : VE.Environment) (K : VE.Discourse.Manifest),
    K.constraints = [] →
      ∀ (sets : List VE.Route.Admission.ReadingSet),
        (∀ (rs : VE.Route.Admission.ReadingSet), rs ∈ sets → rs.readings ≠ []) →

theorem VE.Discourse.presupposition_carried
  ∀ (profiles : List String) (environment : Lean.Json) (rv : VE.Route.Wire.RouteVocabulary) (j : Lean.Json) (fuel : Nat)
    (res : VE.Discourse.Admitted),
    VE.Discourse.admitDiscourse profiles environment rv j fuel = Except.ok res →
      ∀ (m : VE.Discourse.Mention),
        m ∈ res.doc.K.mentions →
          m.reading = Option.some VE.Discourse.Reading.presuppositional →
            ∀ (Dr : VE.Formula),
              m.restriction = Option.some Dr →
                ∀ (σ : String),
                  VE.Discourse.restrictionSort res.doc m = Option.some σ →
                    (∃ n w,
                        res.presuppositions m.id = Option.some (VE.Discourse.PresuppositionCarrier.proved n) ∧
                          w ∈ res.base.wires ∧
                            w.claim.name = n ∧
                              w.unit = Option.none ∧
                                w.deduction.isSome = Bool.true ∧
                                  w.claim.label = "asserted" ∧ w.claim.formula = VE.Discourse.uniqueD σ Dr) ∨
                      (∃ u,
                          res.presuppositions m.id = Option.some (VE.Discourse.PresuppositionCarrier.assumed u) ∧
                            m.presuppositionUnit = Option.some u ∧
                              VE.Route.Admission.AssertedUnit res.base.doc u (VE.Discourse.uniqueD σ Dr) ∧
                                u ∈ res.premiseUnits) ∨
                        res.presuppositions m.id = Option.none ∧
                          (m.unit, "PresuppositionUnresolved: " ++ m.id) ∈ res.pending ∧ res.bound m.unit = Option.none
  -- uses VE.Discourse.Admitted.base@VE.Discourse.Admission VE.Discourse.Admitted.bound@VE.Discourse.Admission VE.Discourse.Admitted.doc@VE.Discourse.Admission VE.Discourse.Admitted.pending@VE.Discourse.Admission VE.Discourse.Admitted.premiseUnits@VE.Discourse.Admission VE.Discourse.Admitted.presuppositions@VE.Discourse.Admission VE.Discourse.Admitted@VE.Discourse.Admission VE.Discourse.DDoc.K@VE.Discourse.Manifest VE.Discourse.Manifest.mentions@VE.Discourse.Manifest VE.Discourse.Mention.id@VE.Discourse.Manifest VE.Discourse.Mention.presuppositionUnit@VE.Discourse.Manifest VE.Discourse.Mention.reading@VE.Discourse.Manifest VE.Discourse.Mention.restriction@VE.Discourse.Manifest VE.Discourse.Mention.unit@VE.Discourse.Manifest VE.Discourse.Mention@VE.Discourse.Manifest VE.Discourse.PresuppositionCarrier.assumed@VE.Discourse.Descriptions VE.Discourse.PresuppositionCarrier.proved@VE.Discourse.Descriptions VE.Discourse.PresuppositionCarrier@VE.Discourse.Descriptions VE.Discourse.Reading.presuppositional@VE.Discourse.Manifest VE.Discourse.Reading@VE.Discourse.Manifest VE.Discourse.admitDiscourse@VE.Discourse.Admission VE.Discourse.restrictionSort@VE.Discourse.WellFormed VE.Discourse.uniqueD@VE.Discourse.Descriptions VE.Formula@VE.Syntax VE.Graph.Claim.formula@VE.ClaimGraph VE.Graph.Claim.label@VE.ClaimGraph VE.Graph.Claim.name@VE.ClaimGraph VE.Graph.Edge@VE.ClaimGraph VE.Route.Admission.Admitted.doc@VE.Route.Admission VE.Route.Admission.Admitted.wires@VE.Route.Admission VE.Route.Admission.AssertedUnit@VE.Route.Admission VE.Route.Admission.WireNode.claim@VE.Route.Admission VE.Route.Admission.WireNode.deduction@VE.Route.Admission VE.Route.Admission.WireNode.unit@VE.Route.Admission VE.Route.Admission.WireNode@VE.Route.Admission VE.Route.Wire.RouteVocabulary@VE.Route.Wire VE.Tableau.Certificate@VE.Tableau

theorem VE.Discourse.validity_import
  ∀ (profiles : List String) (environment : Lean.Json) (rv : VE.Route.Wire.RouteVocabulary) (j : Lean.Json) (fuel : Nat)
    (res : VE.Discourse.Admitted),
    VE.Discourse.admitDiscourse profiles environment rv j (fuel + 1) = Except.ok res →
      ∀ (v : VE.Discourse.Validity),
        v ∈ res.claims →
          ∀ (key : String),
            VE.Discourse.refersImport res.doc v.document key →
              ∀ (imp : VE.Discourse.Import),
                imp ∈ res.doc.K.imports ∧ imp.key = key →
                  (imp.bytes = Option.none →
                      res.validity v.unit = Option.some (VE.Discourse.Verdict.unconfirmed "import bytes absent")) ∧
                    (∀ (b : ByteArray),
                        imp.bytes = Option.some b →
                          res.validity v.unit =
                            Option.some
                              (VE.Discourse.verdictOf v.holds (VE.Discourse.checkImport (j.getObjValD "files") b fuel))) ∧
                      ∀ (b : ByteArray),
                        imp.bytes = Option.some b →
                          VE.Discourse.checkImport (j.getObjValD "files") b fuel =
                            VE.Discourse.outcomeWith (fun ps env rv p => VE.Discourse.admitDiscourse ps env rv p fuel)
                              (j.getObjValD "files") b
  -- uses VE.Discourse.Admitted.claims@VE.Discourse.Admission VE.Discourse.Admitted.doc@VE.Discourse.Admission VE.Discourse.Admitted.validity@VE.Discourse.Admission VE.Discourse.Admitted@VE.Discourse.Admission VE.Discourse.DDoc.K@VE.Discourse.Manifest VE.Discourse.Import.bytes@VE.Discourse.Manifest VE.Discourse.Import.key@VE.Discourse.Manifest VE.Discourse.Import@VE.Discourse.Manifest VE.Discourse.ImportOutcome@VE.Discourse.Documents VE.Discourse.Manifest.imports@VE.Discourse.Manifest VE.Discourse.Validity.document@VE.Discourse.Manifest VE.Discourse.Validity.holds@VE.Discourse.Manifest VE.Discourse.Validity.unit@VE.Discourse.Manifest VE.Discourse.Validity@VE.Discourse.Manifest VE.Discourse.Verdict.unconfirmed@VE.Discourse.Manifest VE.Discourse.Verdict@VE.Discourse.Manifest VE.Discourse.admitDiscourse@VE.Discourse.Admission VE.Discourse.checkImport@VE.Discourse.Admission VE.Discourse.outcomeWith@VE.Discourse.Admission VE.Discourse.refersImport@VE.Discourse.Documents VE.Discourse.verdictOf@VE.Discourse.Documents VE.Route.Wire.RouteVocabulary@VE.Route.Wire

theorem VE.Discourse.validity_self
  ∀ (profiles : List String) (environment : Lean.Json) (rv : VE.Route.Wire.RouteVocabulary) (j : Lean.Json) (fuel : Nat)
    (res : VE.Discourse.Admitted),
    VE.Discourse.admitDiscourse profiles environment rv j fuel = Except.ok res →
      ∀ (v : VE.Discourse.Validity),
        v ∈ res.claims →

theorem VE.EnglishGrammar.policy_selection
  ∀ (E : VE.EnglishGrammar.Env) (O : VE.EnglishGrammar.Overlay) (L : VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon),
    VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon.policyOk E O L = Bool.true →
      (∀ (p w : String),
          (p, w) ∈ L.wordings →
            (E.predicate? p).isSome = Bool.true →
              Option.map (fun x => x.fst) (VE.EnglishGrammar.policyPredicate E O p) = Option.some w ∨
                VE.EnglishGrammar.fallbackWording p (E.arity p) = Option.some w) ∧
        (∀ (p n : String),
            (p, n) ∈ L.negatives →
              (E.predicate? p).isSome = Bool.true →
                ∃ w,
                  VE.EnglishGrammar.policyPredicate E O p = Option.some (w, Option.some n) ∧
                    List.lookup p L.wordings = Option.some w) ∧
          (∀ (s n : String),
              (s, n) ∈ L.nouns →
                ∀ (m : String),
                  List.lookup s (VE.EnglishGrammar.policyNouns E O) = Option.some m →
                    n = m ∨ n = VE.EnglishGrammar.fallbackNoun s) ∧
            ∀ (c sp : String),
              (c, sp) ∈ L.spellings →
                ∀ (m : String),
                  List.lookup c (VE.EnglishGrammar.policySpellings E O) = Option.some m →
                    sp = m ∨ sp = VE.EnglishGrammar.jsonQuote c
  -- uses VE.EnglishGrammar.Env.arity@VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon VE.EnglishGrammar.Env.predicate?@VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon VE.EnglishGrammar.Env@VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon.negatives@VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon.nouns@VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon.policyOk@VE.EnglishGrammar.Policy VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon.spellings@VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon.wordings@VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon@VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon VE.EnglishGrammar.Overlay@VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon VE.EnglishGrammar.PredDecl@VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon VE.EnglishGrammar.fallbackNoun@VE.EnglishGrammar.Policy VE.EnglishGrammar.fallbackWording@VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon VE.EnglishGrammar.jsonQuote@VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon VE.EnglishGrammar.policyNouns@VE.EnglishGrammar.Policy VE.EnglishGrammar.policyPredicate@VE.EnglishGrammar.Policy VE.EnglishGrammar.policySpellings@VE.EnglishGrammar.Policy

theorem VE.EnglishGrammar.read_eq
  ∀ {E : VE.EnglishGrammar.Env} {O : VE.EnglishGrammar.Overlay} {L : VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon} {b : Nat} {s : String},
    VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon.valid E O L = Bool.true →
      (VE.EnglishGrammar.grammar E L).wf = Bool.true →
        VE.EnglishGrammar.terminatorFree (VE.EnglishGrammar.grammar E L) = Bool.true →
          (VE.EnglishGrammar.grammar E L).typed VE.EnglishGrammar.sig (VE.EnglishGrammar.ty E L)
                (VE.EnglishGrammar.acts E L) =
              Bool.true →
            VE.EnglishGrammar.ty E L (VE.EnglishGrammar.grammar E L).start = VE.EnglishGrammar.Ty.sentence →
              VE.EnglishGrammar.read E O L b s =
                match VE.EnglishGrammar.lex s with
                | Except.error r => VE.EnglishGrammar.ReadOutcome.lexical r
                | Except.ok sents =>
                  match
                    VE.Grammar.readDocument (VE.EnglishGrammar.grammar E L)
                      (VE.EnglishGrammar.meaning (VE.EnglishGrammar.grammar E L) (VE.EnglishGrammar.acts E L))
                      VE.EnglishGrammar.DState.init b sents.toList with
                  | (VE.Grammar.DocOutcome.ok rs, snd) =>
                    if VE.EnglishGrammar.typedDocument E (List.map (fun x => x.fst) rs) = Bool.true then
                      VE.EnglishGrammar.ReadOutcome.ok rs
                    else VE.EnglishGrammar.ReadOutcome.illTyped
                  | (VE.Grammar.DocOutcome.stopped i o, snd) => VE.EnglishGrammar.ReadOutcome.stopped i o
  -- uses VE.EnglishGrammar.DState.init@VE.EnglishGrammar.Syntax VE.EnglishGrammar.DState@VE.EnglishGrammar.Syntax VE.EnglishGrammar.EFormula@VE.EnglishGrammar.Syntax VE.EnglishGrammar.Env@VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon.valid@VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon@VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon VE.EnglishGrammar.Overlay@VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon VE.EnglishGrammar.ReadOutcome.illTyped@VE.EnglishGrammar.Read VE.EnglishGrammar.ReadOutcome.lexical@VE.EnglishGrammar.Read VE.EnglishGrammar.ReadOutcome.ok@VE.EnglishGrammar.Read VE.EnglishGrammar.ReadOutcome.stopped@VE.EnglishGrammar.Read VE.EnglishGrammar.ReadOutcome@VE.EnglishGrammar.Read VE.EnglishGrammar.Reject@VE.EnglishGrammar.Syntax VE.EnglishGrammar.Terminal@VE.EnglishGrammar.Token VE.EnglishGrammar.Tok@VE.EnglishGrammar.Token VE.EnglishGrammar.Ty.sentence@VE.EnglishGrammar.Syntax VE.EnglishGrammar.Ty@VE.EnglishGrammar.Syntax VE.EnglishGrammar.acts@VE.EnglishGrammar.Actions VE.EnglishGrammar.grammar@VE.EnglishGrammar.Rules VE.EnglishGrammar.instAcceptsTerminalTok@VE.EnglishGrammar.Token VE.EnglishGrammar.instDecidableEqTerminal@VE.EnglishGrammar.Token VE.EnglishGrammar.instDecidableEqTok@VE.EnglishGrammar.Token VE.EnglishGrammar.lex@VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexer VE.EnglishGrammar.meaning@VE.EnglishGrammar.Read VE.EnglishGrammar.read.match_1@VE.EnglishGrammar.Read VE.EnglishGrammar.read.match_3@VE.EnglishGrammar.Read VE.EnglishGrammar.read@VE.EnglishGrammar.Read VE.EnglishGrammar.sig@VE.EnglishGrammar.Actions VE.EnglishGrammar.terminatorFree@VE.EnglishGrammar.Token VE.EnglishGrammar.ty@VE.EnglishGrammar.Rules VE.EnglishGrammar.typedDocument@VE.EnglishGrammar.Encode VE.Grammar.DocOutcome@VE.Grammar.Reading VE.Grammar.Grammar.start@VE.Grammar.Basic VE.Grammar.Grammar.typed@VE.Grammar.Meaning VE.Grammar.Grammar.wf@VE.Grammar.Basic VE.Grammar.Outcome@VE.Grammar.Reading VE.Grammar.readDocument@VE.Grammar.Reading

theorem VE.EnglishGrammar.read_stopped
  ∀ (E : VE.EnglishGrammar.Env) (O : VE.EnglishGrammar.Overlay) (L : VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon) (b : Nat) (s : String)
    (i : Nat) (o : VE.Grammar.Outcome VE.EnglishGrammar.Tok VE.EnglishGrammar.Reject VE.EnglishGrammar.EFormula),
    VE.EnglishGrammar.read E O L b s = VE.EnglishGrammar.ReadOutcome.stopped i o →
      VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon.valid E O L = Bool.true ∧
        (VE.EnglishGrammar.grammar E L).wf = Bool.true ∧
          VE.EnglishGrammar.terminatorFree (VE.EnglishGrammar.grammar E L) = Bool.true ∧
            (VE.EnglishGrammar.grammar E L).typed VE.EnglishGrammar.sig (VE.EnglishGrammar.ty E L)
                  (VE.EnglishGrammar.acts E L) =
                Bool.true ∧
              VE.EnglishGrammar.ty E L (VE.EnglishGrammar.grammar E L).start = VE.EnglishGrammar.Ty.sentence ∧
                ∃ sents rs st1 w,
                  VE.EnglishGrammar.lex s = Except.ok sents ∧
                    VE.Grammar.DocOneReading (VE.EnglishGrammar.grammar E L)
                        (VE.EnglishGrammar.meaning (VE.EnglishGrammar.grammar E L) (VE.EnglishGrammar.acts E L))
                        VE.EnglishGrammar.DState.init (List.map (fun x => x.toList) (List.take i sents.toList)) rs st1 ∧
                      sents.toList[i]? = Option.some w ∧
                        (VE.Grammar.readSentence (VE.EnglishGrammar.grammar E L)
                                (VE.EnglishGrammar.meaning (VE.EnglishGrammar.grammar E L) (VE.EnglishGrammar.acts E L))
                                st1 b w).fst =
                            o ∧
                          ∀ (A : VE.EnglishGrammar.EFormula) (c : Bool), o ≠ VE.Grammar.Outcome.ok A c
  -- uses VE.EnglishGrammar.DState.init@VE.EnglishGrammar.Syntax VE.EnglishGrammar.DState@VE.EnglishGrammar.Syntax VE.EnglishGrammar.EFormula@VE.EnglishGrammar.Syntax VE.EnglishGrammar.Env@VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon.valid@VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon@VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon VE.EnglishGrammar.Overlay@VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon VE.EnglishGrammar.ReadOutcome.stopped@VE.EnglishGrammar.Read VE.EnglishGrammar.ReadOutcome@VE.EnglishGrammar.Read VE.EnglishGrammar.Reject@VE.EnglishGrammar.Syntax VE.EnglishGrammar.Terminal@VE.EnglishGrammar.Token VE.EnglishGrammar.Tok@VE.EnglishGrammar.Token VE.EnglishGrammar.Ty.sentence@VE.EnglishGrammar.Syntax VE.EnglishGrammar.Ty@VE.EnglishGrammar.Syntax VE.EnglishGrammar.acts@VE.EnglishGrammar.Actions VE.EnglishGrammar.grammar@VE.EnglishGrammar.Rules VE.EnglishGrammar.instAcceptsTerminalTok@VE.EnglishGrammar.Token VE.EnglishGrammar.instDecidableEqTerminal@VE.EnglishGrammar.Token VE.EnglishGrammar.instDecidableEqTok@VE.EnglishGrammar.Token VE.EnglishGrammar.lex@VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexer VE.EnglishGrammar.meaning@VE.EnglishGrammar.Read VE.EnglishGrammar.read@VE.EnglishGrammar.Read VE.EnglishGrammar.sig@VE.EnglishGrammar.Actions VE.EnglishGrammar.terminatorFree@VE.EnglishGrammar.Token VE.EnglishGrammar.ty@VE.EnglishGrammar.Rules VE.Grammar.DocOneReading@VE.Grammar.Reading VE.Grammar.Grammar.start@VE.Grammar.Basic VE.Grammar.Grammar.typed@VE.Grammar.Meaning VE.Grammar.Grammar.wf@VE.Grammar.Basic VE.Grammar.Outcome.ok@VE.Grammar.Reading VE.Grammar.Outcome@VE.Grammar.Reading VE.Grammar.readSentence@VE.Grammar.Reading

            VE.EnglishGrammar.terminatorFree (VE.EnglishGrammar.grammar E L) = Bool.true ∧
              (VE.EnglishGrammar.grammar E L).typed VE.EnglishGrammar.sig (VE.EnglishGrammar.ty E L)
                    (VE.EnglishGrammar.acts E L) =
                  Bool.true ∧
                VE.EnglishGrammar.ty E L (VE.EnglishGrammar.grammar E L).start = VE.EnglishGrammar.Ty.sentence
  -- uses VE.EnglishGrammar.Env@VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon VE.EnglishGrammar.GrammarFault@VE.EnglishGrammar.Read VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon.valid@VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon@VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon VE.EnglishGrammar.Overlay@VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon VE.EnglishGrammar.Terminal@VE.EnglishGrammar.Token VE.EnglishGrammar.Tok@VE.EnglishGrammar.Token VE.EnglishGrammar.TranslateOutcome.invalidGrammar@VE.EnglishGrammar.Read VE.EnglishGrammar.TranslateOutcome@VE.EnglishGrammar.Read VE.EnglishGrammar.Ty.sentence@VE.EnglishGrammar.Syntax VE.EnglishGrammar.Ty@VE.EnglishGrammar.Syntax VE.EnglishGrammar.acts@VE.EnglishGrammar.Actions VE.EnglishGrammar.grammar@VE.EnglishGrammar.Rules VE.EnglishGrammar.sig@VE.EnglishGrammar.Actions VE.EnglishGrammar.terminatorFree@VE.EnglishGrammar.Token VE.EnglishGrammar.translate@VE.EnglishGrammar.Read VE.EnglishGrammar.ty@VE.EnglishGrammar.Rules VE.Grammar.Grammar.start@VE.Grammar.Basic VE.Grammar.Grammar.typed@VE.Grammar.Meaning VE.Grammar.Grammar.wf@VE.Grammar.Basic

theorem VE.EnglishGrammar.translate_eq
  ∀ {E : VE.EnglishGrammar.Env} {O : VE.EnglishGrammar.Overlay} {L : VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon} {cap b : Nat}
    {s : String},
    VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon.valid E O L = Bool.true →
      (VE.EnglishGrammar.grammar E L).wf = Bool.true →
        VE.EnglishGrammar.terminatorFree (VE.EnglishGrammar.grammar E L) = Bool.true →
          (VE.EnglishGrammar.grammar E L).typed VE.EnglishGrammar.sig (VE.EnglishGrammar.ty E L)
                (VE.EnglishGrammar.acts E L) =
              Bool.true →
            VE.EnglishGrammar.ty E L (VE.EnglishGrammar.grammar E L).start = VE.EnglishGrammar.Ty.sentence →
              VE.EnglishGrammar.translate E O L cap b s =
                match VE.EnglishGrammar.lex s with
                | Except.error r => VE.EnglishGrammar.TranslateOutcome.lexical r
                | Except.ok sents =>
                  match sents.toList with
                  | [w] =>
                    match VE.Grammar.parse (VE.EnglishGrammar.grammar E L) cap b w with
                    | Option.none => VE.EnglishGrammar.TranslateOutcome.budget
                    | Option.some ts =>
                      VE.EnglishGrammar.TranslateOutcome.readings
                        (VE.Grammar.readingSet
                          (VE.EnglishGrammar.meaning (VE.EnglishGrammar.grammar E L) (VE.EnglishGrammar.acts E L))
                          VE.EnglishGrammar.DState.init ts)
                        (Decidable.decide (ts.length < cap))
                  | x => VE.EnglishGrammar.TranslateOutcome.notOneSentence
  -- uses VE.EnglishGrammar.DState.init@VE.EnglishGrammar.Syntax VE.EnglishGrammar.DState@VE.EnglishGrammar.Syntax VE.EnglishGrammar.EFormula@VE.EnglishGrammar.Syntax VE.EnglishGrammar.Env@VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon.valid@VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon@VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon VE.EnglishGrammar.Overlay@VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon VE.EnglishGrammar.Reject@VE.EnglishGrammar.Syntax VE.EnglishGrammar.Terminal@VE.EnglishGrammar.Token VE.EnglishGrammar.Tok@VE.EnglishGrammar.Token VE.EnglishGrammar.TranslateOutcome.budget@VE.EnglishGrammar.Read VE.EnglishGrammar.TranslateOutcome.lexical@VE.EnglishGrammar.Read VE.EnglishGrammar.TranslateOutcome.notOneSentence@VE.EnglishGrammar.Read VE.EnglishGrammar.TranslateOutcome.readings@VE.EnglishGrammar.Read VE.EnglishGrammar.TranslateOutcome@VE.EnglishGrammar.Read VE.EnglishGrammar.Ty.sentence@VE.EnglishGrammar.Syntax VE.EnglishGrammar.Ty@VE.EnglishGrammar.Syntax VE.EnglishGrammar.acts@VE.EnglishGrammar.Actions VE.EnglishGrammar.grammar@VE.EnglishGrammar.Rules VE.EnglishGrammar.instAcceptsTerminalTok@VE.EnglishGrammar.Token VE.EnglishGrammar.instDecidableEqTerminal@VE.EnglishGrammar.Token VE.EnglishGrammar.instDecidableEqTok@VE.EnglishGrammar.Token VE.EnglishGrammar.lex@VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexer VE.EnglishGrammar.meaning@VE.EnglishGrammar.Read VE.EnglishGrammar.read.match_3@VE.EnglishGrammar.Read VE.EnglishGrammar.sig@VE.EnglishGrammar.Actions VE.EnglishGrammar.terminatorFree@VE.EnglishGrammar.Token VE.EnglishGrammar.translate.match_1@VE.EnglishGrammar.Read VE.EnglishGrammar.translate.match_3@VE.EnglishGrammar.Read VE.EnglishGrammar.translate@VE.EnglishGrammar.Read VE.EnglishGrammar.ty@VE.EnglishGrammar.Rules VE.Grammar.Grammar.start@VE.Grammar.Basic VE.Grammar.Grammar.typed@VE.Grammar.Meaning VE.Grammar.Grammar.wf@VE.Grammar.Basic VE.Grammar.Tree@VE.Grammar.Derives VE.Grammar.parse@VE.Grammar.Table VE.Grammar.readingSet@VE.Grammar.Reading

theorem VE.Grammar.BOk.addAll
  ∀ {X : Type} {cap n : Nat} {Pold Pnew : Nat → X → Prop} {e : VE.Grammar.Bucket X} {cands : List (Nat × X)},
    VE.Grammar.BOk cap n Pold e →
      (∀ (c : Nat × X), c ∈ cands → c.fst ≤ n ∧ Pnew c.fst c.snd) →
        cands.Nodup →
          (∀ (j : Nat),
              j ≤ n →
                cap ≤ (List.filter (fun c => Decidable.decide (c.fst = j)) cands).length ∨
                  ∀ (x : X), Pnew j x → (j, x) ∈ cands) →
            (∀ (j : Nat) (x : X), Pold j x → ¬Pnew j x) →
              VE.Grammar.BOk cap n (fun j x => Pold j x ∨ Pnew j x) (VE.Grammar.Bucket.addAll cap e cands)
  -- uses VE.Grammar.BOk@VE.Grammar.TableInvariant VE.Grammar.Bucket.addAll@VE.Grammar.Table VE.Grammar.Bucket@VE.Grammar.Table

theorem VE.Grammar.Bucket.merge_spec
  ∀ {X : Type} (cap : Nat) (e : VE.Grammar.Bucket X) (cs : List (Nat × X)),
    e.Sorted →
      VE.Grammar.KeysUp cs →
        (VE.Grammar.Bucket.merge cap e cs).Sorted ∧
          (∀ (p : Nat × List X),
              p ∈ VE.Grammar.Bucket.merge cap e cs → (∃ q, q ∈ e ∧ q.fst = p.fst) ∨ ∃ c, c ∈ cs ∧ c.fst = p.fst) ∧
            ∀ (j : Nat),
              (VE.Grammar.Bucket.merge cap e cs).get j =
                VE.Grammar.addCapped cap (e.get j)
                  (List.map (fun x => x.snd) (List.filter (fun c => Decidable.decide (c.fst = j)) cs))
  -- uses VE.Grammar.Bucket.Sorted@VE.Grammar.TableInvariant VE.Grammar.Bucket.get@VE.Grammar.Table VE.Grammar.Bucket.merge@VE.Grammar.Table VE.Grammar.Bucket@VE.Grammar.Table VE.Grammar.KeysUp@VE.Grammar.TableInvariant VE.Grammar.addCapped@VE.Grammar.TableInvariant

theorem VE.Grammar.combine_ok
  ∀ {T K : Type} [DecidableEq T] [inst : VE.Grammar.Accepts K T] {G : VE.Grammar.Grammar K},
    G.wf = Bool.true →
      ∀ {cap : Nat} {w : Array T} {i : Nat} {Y : VE.Grammar.Sym K} {rest : List (VE.Grammar.Sym K)}
        {first : VE.Grammar.Bucket (VE.Grammar.Tree T)} {next : Nat → VE.Grammar.Bucket (List (VE.Grammar.Tree T))}
        {last : Bool},
        last = rest.isEmpty →
          VE.Grammar.BOk cap w.size (VE.Grammar.Span G w Y i) first →
            (rest ≠ [] →
                ∀ (j1 : Nat),
                  i < j1 → j1 ≤ w.size → VE.Grammar.BOk cap w.size (VE.Grammar.SpanAll G w rest j1) (next j1)) →
              (∀ (c : Nat × List (VE.Grammar.Tree T)),
                  c ∈ VE.Grammar.combine first next last →
                    c.fst ≤ w.size ∧ VE.Grammar.SpanAll G w (Y :: rest) i c.fst c.snd) ∧
                (VE.Grammar.combine first next last).Nodup ∧
                  ∀ (j : Nat),
                    j ≤ w.size →
                      cap ≤
                          (List.filter (fun c => Decidable.decide (c.fst = j))
                              (VE.Grammar.combine first next last)).length ∨
                        ∀ (us : List (VE.Grammar.Tree T)),
                          VE.Grammar.SpanAll G w (Y :: rest) i j us → (j, us) ∈ VE.Grammar.combine first next last
  -- uses VE.Grammar.Accepts@VE.Grammar.Basic VE.Grammar.BOk@VE.Grammar.TableInvariant VE.Grammar.Bucket@VE.Grammar.Table VE.Grammar.Grammar.wf@VE.Grammar.Basic VE.Grammar.Grammar@VE.Grammar.Basic VE.Grammar.Span@VE.Grammar.TableInvariant VE.Grammar.SpanAll@VE.Grammar.TableInvariant VE.Grammar.Sym@VE.Grammar.Basic VE.Grammar.Tree@VE.Grammar.Derives VE.Grammar.combine@VE.Grammar.Table
  -- expr 89619338

  ∀ {T K σ ρ α : Type} [inst : DecidableEq T] [inst_1 : DecidableEq K] [inst_2 : VE.Grammar.Accepts K T]

theorem VE.Grammar.extension_keeps_many
  ∀ {T K σ ρ α : Type} [inst : VE.Grammar.Accepts K T] {G G2 : VE.Grammar.Grammar K} {μ μ2 : VE.Grammar.Meaning T σ ρ α}
    {emb : VE.Grammar.Tree T → VE.Grammar.Tree T} {w : List T} {t u : VE.Grammar.Tree T},
    VE.Grammar.Embeds G G2 μ μ2 emb →
      VE.Grammar.Derives G (VE.Grammar.Sym.n G.start) w t →
        VE.Grammar.Derives G (VE.Grammar.Sym.n G.start) w u →
          t ≠ u →
            VE.Grammar.Derives G2 (VE.Grammar.Sym.n G2.start) w (emb t) ∧
              VE.Grammar.Derives G2 (VE.Grammar.Sym.n G2.start) w (emb u) ∧ emb t ≠ emb u
  -- uses VE.Grammar.Accepts@VE.Grammar.Basic VE.Grammar.Derives@VE.Grammar.Derives VE.Grammar.Embeds@VE.Grammar.Extension VE.Grammar.Grammar.start@VE.Grammar.Basic VE.Grammar.Grammar@VE.Grammar.Basic VE.Grammar.Meaning@VE.Grammar.Reading VE.Grammar.Sym.n@VE.Grammar.Basic VE.Grammar.Tree@VE.Grammar.Derives

  ∀ {T K : Type} [DecidableEq T] [inst : DecidableEq K] [inst_1 : VE.Grammar.Accepts K T] {G : VE.Grammar.Grammar K}

      0 < cap →

theorem VE.Grammar.groupBy_spec
  ∀ {α : Type} {n : Nat} {key : α → Option Nat} {x : α} {k : Nat} (xs : List α) (g : Array (List α)),
    g.size = n →
      (List.foldl (VE.Grammar.groupStep key) g xs).size = n ∧
        (x ∈ (List.foldl (VE.Grammar.groupStep key) g xs).getD k [] ↔
          x ∈ g.getD k [] ∨ x ∈ xs ∧ key x = Option.some k ∧ k < n)

theorem VE.Grammar.ruleStep_ok
  ∀ {T K : Type} [DecidableEq T] [inst : VE.Grammar.Accepts K T] {G : VE.Grammar.Grammar K} {cap : Nat} {w : Array T},
    G.wf = Bool.true →
      0 < cap →
        ∀ {i : Nat},
          i < w.size →
            ∀ {suf : Array (VE.Grammar.SufRow T)},
              (∀ (p : Nat), i < p → p ≤ w.size → VE.Grammar.SufRowOk G cap w p (suf.getD p #[])) →
                ∀ {D : Nat → Prop} {row : VE.Grammar.NtRow T},
                  VE.Grammar.NtOk G cap w i D row →
                    ∀ {R : VE.Grammar.CRule K} {R0 : VE.Grammar.Rule K},
                      G.rules[R.index]? = Option.some R0 →
                        R0.lhs = R.lhs →
                          ∀ {Y : VE.Grammar.Sym K} {rest : List (VE.Grammar.Sym K)},
                            R0.rhs = Y :: rest →
                              ¬D R.index →
                                (∀ (B : Nat),
                                    Y = VE.Grammar.Sym.n B →
                                      ∀ (r : Nat) (R1 : VE.Grammar.Rule K),
                                        G.rules[r]? = Option.some R1 → R1.lhs = B → D r) →
                                  ∀ {row2 : VE.Grammar.NtRow T},
                                    Array.size row2 = Array.size row →
                                      (∀ (A : Nat),
                                          Array.getD row2 A [] =
                                            if A = R.lhs then
                                              VE.Grammar.Bucket.addAll cap (Array.getD row A [])
                                                (List.map (fun c => (c.fst, VE.Grammar.Tree.node R.index c.snd))
                                                  (VE.Grammar.combine (VE.Grammar.firstAt w i row Y)
                                                    (fun j1 => VE.Grammar.sufGet suf j1 R.index 1) rest.isEmpty))

theorem VE.Grammar.verdict_parse
  ∀ {T K : Type} [inst : DecidableEq T] [inst_1 : DecidableEq K] [inst_2 : VE.Grammar.Accepts K T]
    {G : VE.Grammar.Grammar K} {b : Nat} {w : Array T} {v : VE.Grammar.Verdict T},
    VE.Grammar.verdict G b w = Option.some v →
      ∃ ts,
        VE.Grammar.parse G 2 b w = Option.some ts ∧
          match v with
          | VE.Grammar.Verdict.zero => ts = []
          | VE.Grammar.Verdict.one t => ts = [t]
          | VE.Grammar.Verdict.many t u => ∃ rest, ts = t :: u :: rest
  -- uses VE.Grammar.Accepts@VE.Grammar.Basic VE.Grammar.Grammar@VE.Grammar.Basic VE.Grammar.Tree@VE.Grammar.Derives VE.Grammar.Verdict@VE.Grammar.Table VE.Grammar.parse@VE.Grammar.Table VE.Grammar.verdict@VE.Grammar.Table VE.Grammar.verdict_parse.match_1@VE.Grammar.TableProofs

theorem VE.NormDefaults.catala_completed
  ∀ (P N R : Prop) (d : Bool),
    (∃ b, VE.Norms.catalaValue P N d = Option.some b ∧ (R ↔ b = Bool.true)) ↔
      match
        VE.NormDefaults.value3 P N
          (if d = Bool.true then VE.NormDefaults.Completion.allow else VE.NormDefaults.Completion.deny) with
      | VE.NormDefaults.Outcome3.yes => R
      | VE.NormDefaults.Outcome3.no => ¬R
      | VE.NormDefaults.Outcome3.unsaid => True
      | VE.NormDefaults.Outcome3.conflict => False

    (∃ b, VE.Norms.catalaValue (P ∨ V ∧ ¬P ∧ ¬N) N Bool.false = Option.some b ∧ (R ↔ b = Bool.true)) ↔

theorem VE.NormDefaults.fill_sat_of
  ∀ {U : VE.NormDefaults.UDoc},
    VE.NormDefaults.UValid U →
      VE.NormDefaults.WellFormedU U = Bool.true →
        ∀ {B : VE.Structure},
          VE.Norms.BaseAdmissible (VE.NormDefaults.fill U) B →
            (∀ (pr : VE.Norms.Pair),
                pr ∈ VE.Norms.pairs U.D.T →
                  pr.perm ∈ U.unspec →
                    ∀ (vs : List B.Carrier),
                      VE.TupleTyped B pr.sorts vs → B.relation (VE.NormDefaults.unsaidName pr.perm) vs) →

theorem VE.NormDefaults.forIn_cons_ok
  ∀ {α σ ε : Type} (f : α → σ → Except ε (ForInStep σ)) (step : σ → σ) (cond : Prop) (x : α) (l : List α) (s s' : σ),
    ((f x s = Except.ok (ForInStep.yield (step s)) ↔ cond) ∧
        ∀ (r : ForInStep σ), f x s = Except.ok r → r = ForInStep.yield (step s)) →
      (ForIn.forIn (x :: l) s f = Except.ok s' ↔ cond ∧ ForIn.forIn l (step s) f = Except.ok s')

                              Option.some Bool.true →
                            VE.Formula.denote (VE.NormDefaults.withFill U M.asStructure F) (VE.Norms.tupleVal vs)
                              (VE.NormDefaults.gapF U r.name)

theorem VE.NormDefaults.outcomeBase_fill
  ∀ {U : VE.NormDefaults.UDoc},
    VE.NormDefaults.WellFormedU U = Bool.true →
      ∀ {B : VE.Structure},
        VE.Norms.ConstantsTyped (VE.NormDefaults.fill U) B →
          ∀ {q : VE.Norms.Regulated},
            q ∈ U.D.T.regulated →
              ∀ (vs : List B.Carrier),
                VE.TupleTyped B q.sorts vs →
                  (VE.Formula.denote B (VE.Norms.tupleVal vs) (VE.Norms.outcomeBase (VE.NormDefaults.fill U) q.name) ↔
                    if q.allowByDefault = Bool.true then
                      ¬VE.Norms.DecidesD (VE.NormDefaults.fill U).T (VE.SoftNorms.canon (VE.NormDefaults.fill U) B)
                          (VE.Norms.tupleVal vs) q.name Bool.false
                    else
                      VE.Norms.DecidesD (VE.NormDefaults.fill U).T (VE.SoftNorms.canon (VE.NormDefaults.fill U) B)
                        (VE.Norms.tupleVal vs) q.name Bool.true)

    VE.Norms.Admission.admitDocument environment document = Except.ok res →
      VE.Norms.Admission.SourceDecoded environment document res ∧

theorem VE.Norms.Flagged.norms_flagged_acceptance
  ∀ (j : Lean.Json) (r : VE.Norms.Replay.EntailmentReplay),
    VE.Norms.Flagged.replayEntailment j = Except.ok r →
      VE.Norms.Flagged.valid r = Bool.true →
        VE.Norms.Wire.decodeSource (j.getObjValD "environment") (j.getObjValD "norms") Bool.true = Except.ok r.src ∧
          (∀ (S : VE.Structure),
              S.Admissible (VE.Norms.envAt r.src.D (VE.Norms.size r.src.D)) →
                VE.Norms.Sat S (VE.Norms.Flagged.flagPremises r.src) →
                  VE.Norms.holdsCatala r.src.D.T S →
                    VE.Norms.definitionsHold r.src.D S →
                      VE.Norms.profileHold r.src.D S →
                        VE.Norms.Sat S (VE.Norms.backgroundBase r.src.D) →
                          VE.Norms.Sat S r.premises → VE.Formula.denote S [] r.conclusion) ∧
            (VE.Norms.Flagged.flagPremises r.src = [] →
              (∀ (B : VE.Structure), VE.Norms.BaseAdmissible r.src.D B → VE.Norms.ConflictFree r.src.D B) →
                (∀ (a : VE.Formula), a ∈ r.premises → VE.Formula.WellFormed (VE.Norms.envAt r.src.D 0) [] a) →
                  VE.Formula.WellFormed (VE.Norms.envAt r.src.D 0) [] r.conclusion →
                    ∀ (B : VE.Structure),
                      VE.Norms.BaseAdmissible r.src.D B → VE.Norms.Sat B r.premises → VE.Formula.denote B [] r.conclusion)

  ∀ (D : VE.Norms.Doc),
    VE.Norms.WellFormed D = Bool.true →
      VE.Norms.InFragment D = Bool.true →

          (∀ (c s : String), D.E.constants c = Option.some s → c ∈ cs) →

              pr ∈ VE.Norms.pairs D.T →
                ∀ (S : VE.Structure),
                  VE.Norms.BaseAdmissible D S →

                      VE.TupleTyped S pr.sorts vs →
                        VE.Formula.denote S (VE.Norms.tupleVal vs) (VE.Norms.pairConflict D pr) →

theorem VE.Norms.elabBody_denote
  ∀ (T : VE.Norms.Tree) (r : VE.Norms.Regulated),
    VE.Norms.Arity r.sorts →

                    ¬VE.Formula.denote S (VE.Norms.tupleVal vs) (VE.Norms.neg T r.name) →
                  (S.relation r.name vs ↔ r.allowByDefault = Bool.true)))

theorem VE.Norms.norms_route_acceptance
  ∀ (D : VE.Norms.Doc),
    VE.Norms.WellFormed D = Bool.true →
      (∀ (B : VE.Structure), VE.Norms.BaseAdmissible D B → VE.Norms.ConflictFree D B) →
        ∀ (Γ : List VE.Formula) (φ : VE.Formula) (c : VE.Tableau.Certificate),
          VE.Tableau.checkCertificate (VE.Norms.envAt D (VE.Norms.size D))
                (VE.Norms.background D ++ VE.Norms.elaborate D.T ++ Γ) φ c =
              Bool.true →
            (∀ (S : VE.Structure),
                S.Admissible (VE.Norms.envAt D (VE.Norms.size D)) →
                  VE.Norms.holdsCatala D.T S →
                    VE.Norms.definitionsHold D S →
                      VE.Norms.profileHold D S →
                        VE.Norms.Sat S (VE.Norms.backgroundBase D) → VE.Norms.Sat S Γ → VE.Formula.denote S [] φ) ∧
              ((∀ (a : VE.Formula), a ∈ Γ → VE.Formula.WellFormed (VE.Norms.envAt D 0) [] a) →
                VE.Formula.WellFormed (VE.Norms.envAt D 0) [] φ →
                  ∀ (B : VE.Structure), VE.Norms.BaseAdmissible D B → VE.Norms.Sat B Γ → VE.Formula.denote B [] φ)
  -- uses VE.Formula.WellFormed@VE.Syntax VE.Formula.denote@VE.Semantics VE.Formula@VE.Syntax VE.Norms.BaseAdmissible@VE.Norms.Prefix VE.Norms.ConflictFree@VE.Norms.Conflict VE.Norms.Doc.T@VE.Norms.Tree VE.Norms.Doc@VE.Norms.Tree VE.Norms.Sat@VE.Norms.Prefix VE.Norms.WellFormed@VE.Norms.Tree VE.Norms.background@VE.Norms.Prefix VE.Norms.backgroundBase@VE.Norms.Prefix VE.Norms.definitionsHold@VE.Norms.Layer VE.Norms.elaborate@VE.Norms.Elaborate VE.Norms.envAt@VE.Norms.Tree VE.Norms.holdsCatala@VE.Norms.Elaborate VE.Norms.profileHold@VE.Norms.Layer VE.Norms.size@VE.Norms.Tree VE.Structure.Admissible@VE.Semantics VE.Structure.Carrier@VE.Semantics VE.Structure@VE.Semantics VE.Tableau.Certificate@VE.Tableau VE.Tableau.checkCertificate@VE.TableauChecker

theorem VE.Norms.pair_members
  ∀ {D : VE.Norms.Doc},
    VE.Norms.Valid D →
      ∀ {pr : VE.Norms.Pair},
        pr ∈ VE.Norms.pairs D.T →
          pr.req ≠ pr.perm ∧
            (∃ i r,
                (VE.Norms.syms D.T)[i]? = Option.some (VE.Norms.Sym.reg r) ∧
                  r.name = pr.req ∧ r.sorts = pr.sorts ∧ VE.Norms.idx D.T pr.req = i) ∧
              ∃ j m,

theorem VE.Norms.pairsAt_members
  ∀ {D : VE.Norms.Doc},
    VE.Norms.Valid D →
      ∀ {k : Nat} {q : VE.Norms.Sym},
        (VE.Norms.syms D.T)[k]? = Option.some q →
          ∀ {pr : VE.Norms.Pair},
            pr ∈ VE.Norms.pairsAt D.T k →
              ∃ r,
                q = VE.Norms.Sym.reg r ∧
                  r.sorts = pr.sorts ∧
                    ((pr.req = q.name ∧
                        ∃ j m, j < k ∧ (VE.Norms.syms D.T)[j]? = Option.some (VE.Norms.Sym.reg m) ∧ m.name = pr.perm) ∨
                      pr.perm = q.name ∧
                        ∃ j m, j < k ∧ (VE.Norms.syms D.T)[j]? = Option.some (VE.Norms.Sym.reg m) ∧ m.name = pr.req)

theorem VE.Norms.restrict_witness
  ∀ (D : VE.Norms.Doc) (cs : List String),
    (∀ (c s : String), D.E.constants c = Option.some s → c ∈ cs) →
      ∀ (S : VE.Structure),
        VE.Norms.BaseAdmissible D S →
          ∀ (sorts : List String) (vs : List S.Carrier),
            VE.TupleTyped S sorts vs →
              ∀ (φ : VE.Formula),
                VE.Norms.Formula.qfree φ = Bool.true →
                  VE.Formula.WellFormed (VE.Norms.envAt D 0) sorts.reverse φ →
                    VE.Formula.denote S (VE.Norms.tupleVal vs) φ →
                      ∃ α inst M ws,
                        M.Valid (VE.Norms.envAt D 0) ∧
                          VE.Norms.backgroundValid D M = Bool.true ∧
                            VE.TupleTyped M.asStructure sorts ws ∧
                              (∀ (s : String),
                                  (M.domains s).length ≤
                                    Max.max 1 (VE.Norms.constantsOfSort D cs s + VE.Norms.witnessVarsOfSort sorts s)) ∧
                                VE.Formula.eval M (VE.Norms.tupleVal ws) φ = Bool.true

theorem VE.Question.first_pred_unique
  ∀ {α : Type} [inst : DecidableEq α] (xs : List α) (P : α → Prop) (c d : α),
    c ∈ xs →
      d ∈ xs →
        P c →
          P d →
            (∀ (x : α), x ∈ List.takeWhile (fun x => x != c) xs → ¬P x) →
              (∀ (x : α), x ∈ List.takeWhile (fun x => x != d) xs → ¬P x) → c = d

theorem VE.Readings.TwinDocs.core
  ∀ {D : VE.Readings.Doc} {s : String} {i j : Nat} {ci cj : VE.Compose.Content} {Nd : VE.SoftNorms.SoftNode},
    VE.Readings.TwinDocs D s i j ci cj Nd →
      VE.Readings.Twin (VE.Rights.correlate (VE.Readings.one D s i).fst) Nd →
        VE.SoftNorms.SoftValid (VE.Rights.correlate (VE.Readings.one D s i).fst) →
          (∃ M, M ∈ (VE.Rights.correlate (VE.Readings.one D s i).fst).T.nodes ∧ M.name = Nd.name) →
            (∀ (d : VE.Norms.Definition),
                d ∈ (VE.Rights.correlate (VE.Readings.one D s i).fst).T.definitions →
                  d.name ≠ VE.SoftNorms.exceptedName Nd) →
              (∀ (e : VE.SoftNorms.Exception), Nd.exception = Option.some e → e.sufficient = []) →
                (∀ (a : VE.Formula),
                    a ∈ (VE.Readings.one D s i).snd →
                      VE.Formula.WellFormed
                        (VE.Norms.envAt (VE.SoftNorms.soften (VE.Rights.correlate (VE.Readings.one D s i).fst))
                          (VE.Norms.size (VE.SoftNorms.soften (VE.Rights.correlate (VE.Readings.one D s i).fst))))
                        [] a) →
                  ∀ (S : VE.Structure),
                    (∀ (vs : List S.Carrier), ¬S.relation (VE.SoftNorms.exceptedName Nd) vs) →
                      ∀ (q : VE.Readings.Probe S.Carrier) (v : Bool),
                        VE.Rights.BaseAdmissibleR (VE.Readings.one D s i).fst S ∧
                            VE.Readings.Observes (VE.Readings.one D s i).fst (VE.Readings.one D s i).snd S q v ↔
                          VE.Rights.BaseAdmissibleR (VE.Readings.one D s j).fst S ∧
                            VE.Readings.Observes (VE.Readings.one D s j).fst (VE.Readings.one D s j).snd S q v

theorem VE.Readings.assertions_canon
  ∀ {D : VE.Readings.Doc},
    VE.Readings.Hyps D →
      ∀ {c : VE.Readings.Choice},
        VE.Readings.Compatible D c →
          ∀ (B : VE.Structure),
            (∀ (x s : String),
                (VE.SoftNorms.soften (VE.Readings.sup D).fst.soft).E.constants x = Option.some s →
                  ∃ v, B.constant x = Option.some v) →
              VE.Readings.Encodes D c B →
                (VE.Norms.Sat (VE.SoftNorms.canon (VE.SoftNorms.soften (VE.Readings.sup D).fst.soft) B)
                    (VE.Readings.sup D).snd ↔
                  VE.Norms.Sat
                    (VE.SoftNorms.canon (VE.SoftNorms.soften (VE.Readings.choiceDoc D c).fst.soft)

theorem VE.Readings.build_fillDoc
  ∀ (N : VE.Readings.NDoc),
    N.D.frame.soft.T.nodes = [] →
      ∀ (keep keep' : String → Bool) (pick pick' : VE.Readings.ReadingSet → Option VE.Readings.Candidate),
        (∀ (u : String) (c : VE.Compose.Content) (cs : List (String × List String)),
            VE.Readings.Item.fixed u c cs ∈ N.D.items → keep' u = keep u) →
          (∀ (u : String) (b : VE.Rights.Bar), VE.Readings.Item.bar u b ∈ N.D.items → keep' u = keep u) →
            (∀ (R : VE.Readings.ReadingSet),
                VE.Readings.Item.set R ∈ N.D.items →
                  pick' (VE.Readings.fillSet N R) = Option.map (VE.Readings.fillCand N) (pick R)) →
              (∀ (r : VE.Norms.Regulated),
                  r ∈ N.D.frame.soft.T.regulated →
                    r.name ∈ N.unspec → keep' (VE.NormDefaults.fillName r.name) = Bool.true) →
                VE.Readings.build (VE.Readings.fillDoc N) keep' pick' =
                  (VE.Readings.addNodes
                      (VE.Readings.fillX N (VE.Readings.fillFrameEnv N) (VE.Readings.build N.D keep pick).fst)
                      (VE.Readings.fillUnitNodes N),
                    (VE.Readings.build N.D keep pick).snd)

theorem VE.Readings.choiceExt_denote
  ∀ {D : VE.Readings.Doc} {E : VE.Environment},
    ¬"ve__reading" ∈ E.sorts →
      E.constants "ve__here" = Option.none →
        (∀ (p : String), p ∈ List.map (fun x => x.fst) (VE.Readings.bitDecls D) → E.predicates p = Option.none) →
          ∀ {S : VE.Structure} (R : String → List S.Carrier → Prop) (dom : String → S.Carrier → Prop)
            (k : String → Option S.Carrier),
            (∀ (p : String),
                ¬p ∈ List.map (fun x => x.fst) (VE.Readings.bitDecls D) →
                  ∀ (vs : List S.Carrier), R p vs ↔ S.relation p vs) →
              (∀ (σ : String), σ ≠ "ve__reading" → dom σ = S.domain σ) →
                (∀ (x : String), x ≠ "ve__here" → k x = S.constant x) →
                  ∀ (φ : VE.Formula) (Γ : List String) (ρ : VE.Valuation S),
                    VE.Formula.WellFormed E Γ φ →
                      (VE.Formula.denote { Carrier := S.Carrier, domain := dom, constant := k, relation := R } ρ φ ↔
                        VE.Formula.denote S ρ φ)
  -- uses VE.Environment.constants@VE.Syntax VE.Environment.predicates@VE.Syntax VE.Environment.sorts@VE.Syntax VE.Environment@VE.Syntax VE.Formula.WellFormed@VE.Syntax VE.Formula.denote@VE.Semantics VE.Formula@VE.Syntax VE.Readings.Doc@VE.Readings.Doc VE.Readings.bitDecls@VE.Readings.Choice VE.Structure.Carrier@VE.Semantics VE.Structure.constant@VE.Semantics VE.Structure.domain@VE.Semantics VE.Structure.mk@VE.Semantics VE.Structure.relation@VE.Semantics VE.Structure@VE.Semantics VE.Valuation@VE.Semantics

    VE.Readings.Hyps D →

  ∀ {D : VE.Readings.Doc},
    VE.Readings.Hyps D →

                  VE.SoftNorms.sortsOf (VE.Readings.choiceDoc D c).fst.soft M.pred =
                      VE.SoftNorms.sortsOf (VE.Readings.choiceDoc D c).fst.soft N.pred →

                          ¬(VE.SoftNorms.SelectsSoftD (VE.Readings.choiceDoc D c).fst.soft
                                (VE.SoftNorms.canon (VE.SoftNorms.soften (VE.Readings.choiceDoc D c).fst.soft) S)

                                (VE.SoftNorms.canon (VE.SoftNorms.soften (VE.Readings.choiceDoc D c).fst.soft) S)
                                (VE.Norms.tupleVal vs) (VE.SoftNorms.fuel (VE.Readings.choiceDoc D c).fst.soft) N))

  ∀ {D : VE.Readings.Doc},
    VE.Readings.Hyps D →
      ∀ {c : VE.Readings.Choice} {N C : VE.SoftNorms.SoftNode},
        N ∈ (VE.Readings.choiceDoc D c).fst.soft.T.nodes →
          C ∈
              VE.SoftNorms.childrenIn (List.map VE.SoftNorms.coreNode (VE.Readings.choiceDoc D c).fst.soft.T.nodes)

theorem VE.Readings.core_model
  ∀ (D : VE.Readings.Doc),
    VE.Readings.supReady D = Bool.true →
      ∀ (E : VE.Environment) (c : VE.Readings.Choice),

theorem VE.Readings.core_sat
  ∀ {D : VE.Readings.Doc},
    VE.Readings.supReady D = Bool.true →
      ∀ {c : VE.Readings.Choice},
        VE.Readings.Compatible D c →
          ∀ {S : VE.Structure},
            (∀ (s : String) (i : Nat), VE.Formula.denote S [] (VE.Readings.choiceAtom D s i) ↔ (s, i) ∈ c) →
              (∀ (m : Nat),
                  m < D.sets.length →
                    ∀ (i : Nat),
                      i < 2 ^ VE.Readings.bitsOf (VE.Readings.setSize D m) →
                        (VE.Formula.denote S [] (VE.Readings.pattern (m + 1) (VE.Readings.setSize D m) i) ↔
                          i = VE.Readings.chosenIdx D c m)) →
                ∀ (a : VE.Formula), a ∈ VE.Readings.choiceCore D → VE.Formula.denote S [] a

theorem VE.Readings.decides_canon
  ∀ {C : VE.SoftNorms.SoftDoc} {Nd : VE.SoftNorms.SoftNode},
    VE.Readings.Twin C Nd →
      VE.SoftNorms.SoftValid C →
        ∀ (S : VE.Structure),
          VE.Norms.ConstantsTyped (VE.SoftNorms.soften C) S →
            (∀ (ρ : VE.Valuation (VE.SoftNorms.canon (VE.SoftNorms.soften (VE.Readings.relaxDoc C Nd)) S)),
                ¬VE.Formula.denote (VE.SoftNorms.canon (VE.SoftNorms.soften (VE.Readings.relaxDoc C Nd)) S) ρ
                    (VE.SoftNorms.exceptedF C Nd)) →
              ∀ {r : VE.Norms.Regulated},
                r ∈ C.T.regulated →
                  ∀ (vs : List S.Carrier),
                    VE.TupleTyped S r.sorts vs →
                      ∀ (sign : Bool),
                        VE.SoftNorms.DecidesSoftD C (VE.SoftNorms.canon (VE.SoftNorms.soften C) S) (VE.Norms.tupleVal vs)
                            r.name sign ↔
                          VE.SoftNorms.DecidesSoftD (VE.Readings.relaxDoc C Nd)
                            (VE.SoftNorms.canon (VE.SoftNorms.soften (VE.Readings.relaxDoc C Nd)) S)
                            (VE.Norms.tupleVal vs) r.name sign
  -- uses VE.Formula.denote@VE.Semantics VE.Norms.ConstantsTyped@VE.Norms.Subst VE.Norms.Regulated.name@VE.Norms.Tree VE.Norms.Regulated.sorts@VE.Norms.Tree VE.Norms.Regulated@VE.Norms.Tree VE.Norms.tupleVal@VE.Norms.Basic VE.Readings.Twin@VE.Readings.Force VE.Readings.relaxDoc@VE.Readings.Force VE.SoftNorms.DecidesSoftD@VE.SoftNorms.Semantics VE.SoftNorms.SoftDoc.T@VE.SoftNorms.Tree VE.SoftNorms.SoftDoc@VE.SoftNorms.Tree VE.SoftNorms.SoftNode@VE.SoftNorms.Tree VE.SoftNorms.SoftTree.regulated@VE.SoftNorms.Tree VE.SoftNorms.SoftValid@VE.SoftNorms.Soften VE.SoftNorms.canon@VE.SoftNorms.Coherence VE.SoftNorms.exceptedF@VE.SoftNorms.Soften VE.SoftNorms.soften@VE.SoftNorms.Soften VE.Structure.Carrier@VE.Semantics VE.Structure@VE.Semantics VE.TupleTyped@VE.Semantics VE.Valuation@VE.Semantics

theorem VE.Readings.decisionOnly_spec
  ∀ (D : VE.Readings.Doc) (s : String) (i j : Nat) (k : VE.Readings.GenKey),
    VE.Readings.decisionOnly D s i j = Option.some k →
      ∃ ci cj Ns Nd,
        ((VE.Readings.candidate D s i).bind fun x => x.content) = Option.some ci ∧
          ((VE.Readings.candidate D s j).bind fun x => x.content) = Option.some cj ∧

              k = VE.Readings.GenKey.excepted Nd.name Option.none ∧
                (∀ (e : VE.SoftNorms.Exception), Nd.exception = Option.some e → e.sufficient = []) ∧
                  ∀ (M : VE.SoftNorms.SoftNode),
                    M ∈ (VE.Rights.correlate (VE.Readings.one D s j).fst).T.nodes →
                      VE.SoftNorms.act (VE.Rights.correlate (VE.Readings.one D s j).fst) M =
                          VE.SoftNorms.act (VE.Rights.correlate (VE.Readings.one D s j).fst) Nd →
                        M.name = Nd.name

theorem VE.Readings.denote_relation_congr
  ∀ (E : VE.Environment) (S : VE.Structure) (R : String → List S.Carrier → Prop),
    (∀ (p : String) (ss : List String),
        E.predicates p = Option.some ss → ∀ (vs : List S.Carrier), vs.length = ss.length → (S.relation p vs ↔ R p vs)) →
      ∀ (φ : VE.Formula) (Γ : List String) (ρ : VE.Valuation S),
        VE.Formula.check E Γ φ = Bool.true →
          (VE.Formula.denote S ρ φ ↔
            VE.Formula.denote { Carrier := S.Carrier, domain := S.domain, constant := S.constant, relation := R } ρ φ)

theorem VE.Readings.distinctAcrossSets_spec
  ∀ (D : VE.Readings.Doc),
    VE.Readings.distinctAcrossSets D = Bool.true ↔
      (∀ (R : VE.Readings.ReadingSet),
          R ∈ D.sets →
            ∀ (n : String × String),
              n ∈ VE.Readings.declaredBy R →
                ∀ (u : String) (c : VE.Compose.Content) (cs : List (String × List String)),
                  VE.Readings.Item.fixed u c cs ∈ D.items → ∀ (m : String × String), m ∈ c.declared → m.snd ≠ n.snd) ∧
        (∀ (R : VE.Readings.ReadingSet),
            R ∈ D.sets →
              ∀ (n : String × String),
                n ∈ VE.Readings.declaredBy R →
                  ∀ (u : String) (b : VE.Rights.Bar), VE.Readings.Item.bar u b ∈ D.items → b.name ≠ n.snd) ∧
          (∀ (R : VE.Readings.ReadingSet),
              R ∈ D.sets →
                ∀ (R' : VE.Readings.ReadingSet),
                  R' ∈ D.sets →
                    R.id ≠ R'.id →
                      ∀ (n : String × String),
                        n ∈ VE.Readings.declaredBy R →
                          ∀ (m : String × String), m ∈ VE.Readings.declaredBy R' → m.snd ≠ n.snd) ∧
            List.Pairwise (fun x y => ∀ (n : String), n ∈ x.names → ¬n ∈ y.names) D.items
  -- uses VE.Compose.Content.declared@VE.Compose.Content VE.Compose.Content@VE.Compose.Content VE.Readings.Doc.items@VE.Readings.Doc VE.Readings.Doc.sets@VE.Readings.Doc VE.Readings.Doc@VE.Readings.Doc VE.Readings.Item.bar@VE.Readings.Doc VE.Readings.Item.fixed@VE.Readings.Doc VE.Readings.Item.names@VE.Readings.Doc VE.Readings.Item@VE.Readings.Doc VE.Readings.ReadingSet.id@VE.Readings.Doc VE.Readings.ReadingSet@VE.Readings.Doc VE.Readings.declaredBy@VE.Readings.Doc VE.Readings.distinctAcrossSets@VE.Readings.Doc VE.Rights.Bar.name@VE.Rights.Tree VE.Rights.Bar@VE.Rights.Tree
  -- expr 2917254328

theorem VE.Readings.ext_denote
  ∀ {E : VE.Environment},
    ¬"ve__reading" ∈ E.sorts →
      E.constants "ve__here" = Option.none →
        ∀ {S : VE.Structure} (R : String → List S.Carrier → Prop) (dom : String → S.Carrier → Prop)
          (k : String → Option S.Carrier),
          (∀ (p : String) (ss : List String),
              E.predicates p = Option.some ss → ∀ (vs : List S.Carrier), R p vs ↔ S.relation p vs) →
            (∀ (σ : String), σ ≠ "ve__reading" → dom σ = S.domain σ) →
              (∀ (x : String), x ≠ "ve__here" → k x = S.constant x) →
                ∀ (φ : VE.Formula) (Γ : List String) (ρ : VE.Valuation S),
                  VE.Formula.WellFormed E Γ φ →
                    (VE.Formula.denote { Carrier := S.Carrier, domain := dom, constant := k, relation := R } ρ φ ↔
                      VE.Formula.denote S ρ φ)
  -- uses VE.Environment.constants@VE.Syntax VE.Environment.predicates@VE.Syntax VE.Environment.sorts@VE.Syntax VE.Environment@VE.Syntax VE.Formula.WellFormed@VE.Syntax VE.Formula.denote@VE.Semantics VE.Formula@VE.Syntax VE.Structure.Carrier@VE.Semantics VE.Structure.constant@VE.Semantics VE.Structure.domain@VE.Semantics VE.Structure.mk@VE.Semantics VE.Structure.relation@VE.Semantics VE.Structure@VE.Semantics VE.Valuation@VE.Semantics

theorem VE.Readings.fmap_exception
  ∀ {D : VE.Readings.Doc},
    VE.Readings.Hyps D →
      ∀ (c : VE.Readings.Choice) (B : VE.Structure),
        VE.Readings.Encodes D c B →
          ∀ {N : VE.SoftNorms.SoftNode},
            N ∈ (VE.Readings.choiceDoc D c).fst.soft.T.nodes →
              ∀ {e : VE.SoftNorms.Exception},
                N.exception = Option.some e →
                  ∃ e',
                    (VE.Readings.fmap D c N).exception = Option.some e' ∧
                      e'.necessary = e.necessary ∧
                        ∀ (ρ : VE.Valuation B) (C : VE.Formula),
                          C ∈ e.sufficient →
                            ∃ C', C' ∈ e'.sufficient ∧ (VE.Formula.denote B ρ C' ↔ VE.Formula.denote B ρ C)

theorem VE.Readings.genKeys_keys
  ∀ (X : VE.Rights.RightsDoc),
    List.map (fun x => x.fst) (VE.Readings.genKeys X) =
      List.map (fun e => VE.Readings.GenKey.excepted e.snd.fst e.snd.snd)
                  (List.filter (fun e => e.fst.mode == VE.SoftNorms.Mode.default) (VE.Readings.keyedNodes X)) ++
                List.flatMap (fun e => List.map (fun π => VE.Readings.GenKey.off e.snd.fst e.snd.snd π) e.fst.alterable)
                  (VE.Readings.keyedNodes X) ++
              List.map (fun x => VE.Readings.GenKey.outweighs x.fst x.snd.fst x.snd.snd)
                (VE.SoftNorms.outweighsTriples (VE.Rights.correlate X)) ++
            List.map (fun k => VE.Readings.GenKey.lim k.fst k.snd) (VE.Rights.limKeys X) ++
          List.map (fun k => VE.Readings.GenKey.cond k.fst k.snd.fst k.snd.snd) (VE.Rights.condKeys X) ++
        if X.bars = [] then [] else List.map VE.Readings.GenKey.aimed (VE.Rights.barPreds X)
  -- uses VE.Readings.GenKey.aimed@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Readings.GenKey.cond@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Readings.GenKey.excepted@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Readings.GenKey.lim@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Readings.GenKey.off@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Readings.GenKey.outweighs@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Readings.GenKey@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Readings.genKeys@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Readings.keyedNodes@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Rights.Bar@VE.Rights.Tree VE.Rights.RightsDoc.bars@VE.Rights.Tree VE.Rights.RightsDoc@VE.Rights.Tree VE.Rights.barPreds@VE.Rights.Tree VE.Rights.condKeys@VE.Rights.Tree VE.Rights.correlate@VE.Rights.Correlate VE.Rights.instDecidableEqBar@VE.Rights.Tree VE.Rights.limKeys@VE.Rights.Tree VE.SoftNorms.Mode.default@VE.SoftNorms.Tree VE.SoftNorms.Mode@VE.SoftNorms.Tree VE.SoftNorms.SoftNode.alterable@VE.SoftNorms.Tree VE.SoftNorms.SoftNode.mode@VE.SoftNorms.Tree VE.SoftNorms.SoftNode@VE.SoftNorms.Tree VE.SoftNorms.instDecidableEqMode@VE.SoftNorms.Tree VE.SoftNorms.outweighsTriples@VE.SoftNorms.Tree

theorem VE.Readings.observes_twin
  ∀ {Xs Xd : VE.Rights.RightsDoc} {Nd : VE.SoftNorms.SoftNode},
    VE.Rights.correlate Xd = VE.Readings.relaxDoc (VE.Rights.correlate Xs) Nd →
      VE.Readings.Twin (VE.Rights.correlate Xs) Nd →
        VE.SoftNorms.SoftValid (VE.Rights.correlate Xs) →
          (∃ M, M ∈ (VE.Rights.correlate Xs).T.nodes ∧ M.name = Nd.name) →
            (∀ (d : VE.Norms.Definition),
                d ∈ (VE.Rights.correlate Xs).T.definitions → d.name ≠ VE.SoftNorms.exceptedName Nd) →
              (∀ (k p : String),
                  VE.Readings.selectable Xd k p = List.map (VE.Readings.relaxTo Nd) (VE.Readings.selectable Xs k p)) →
