theorem VE.Readings.outcome_canon_valid
  ∀ {Z : VE.SoftNorms.SoftDoc},
    VE.Norms.Valid (VE.SoftNorms.soften Z) →
      ∀ (B : VE.Structure),
        VE.Norms.ConstantsTyped (VE.SoftNorms.soften Z) B →
          ∀ {r : VE.Norms.Regulated},
            r ∈ Z.T.regulated →
              ∀ (vs : List B.Carrier),
                VE.TupleTyped B r.sorts vs →
                  (VE.Formula.denote B (VE.Norms.tupleVal vs) (VE.Norms.outcomeBase (VE.SoftNorms.soften Z) r.name) ↔
                    if r.allowByDefault = Bool.true then
                      ¬VE.SoftNorms.DecidesSoftD Z (VE.SoftNorms.canon (VE.SoftNorms.soften Z) B) (VE.Norms.tupleVal vs)
                          r.name Bool.false
                    else

theorem VE.Readings.outweighs_triple
  ∀ {D : VE.Readings.Doc},
    VE.Readings.Hyps D →
      ∀ (c : VE.Readings.Choice) {M N : VE.SoftNorms.SoftNode},
        M ∈ (VE.Readings.choiceDoc D c).fst.soft.T.nodes →
          N ∈ (VE.Readings.choiceDoc D c).fst.soft.T.nodes →
            VE.SoftNorms.Incompatible (VE.Readings.choiceDoc D c).fst.soft M N = Bool.true →
              M.mode = VE.SoftNorms.Mode.default →
                N.mode = VE.SoftNorms.Mode.default →
                  (VE.Readings.choiceDoc D c).fst.soft.soft.outranking = VE.SoftNorms.Outranking.holistic →
                    (VE.SoftNorms.higher (VE.Readings.choiceDoc D c).fst.soft M N = Bool.true →
                        (VE.SoftNorms.act (VE.Readings.choiceDoc D c).fst.soft N, VE.SoftNorms.rk N, VE.SoftNorms.rk M) ∈
                          VE.SoftNorms.outweighsTriples (VE.Readings.choiceDoc D c).fst.soft) ∧
                      (VE.SoftNorms.higher (VE.Readings.choiceDoc D c).fst.soft N M = Bool.true →
                        (VE.SoftNorms.act (VE.Readings.choiceDoc D c).fst.soft N, VE.SoftNorms.rk M, VE.SoftNorms.rk N) ∈
                          VE.SoftNorms.outweighsTriples (VE.Readings.choiceDoc D c).fst.soft)
  -- uses VE.Formula@VE.Syntax VE.Readings.Choice@VE.Readings.Choice VE.Readings.Doc@VE.Readings.Doc VE.Readings.Hyps@VE.Readings.ChoiceFacts VE.Readings.choiceDoc@VE.Readings.Choice VE.Rights.RightsDoc.soft@VE.Rights.Tree VE.Rights.RightsDoc@VE.Rights.Tree VE.SoftNorms.Incompatible@VE.SoftNorms.Tree VE.SoftNorms.Mode.default@VE.SoftNorms.Tree VE.SoftNorms.Mode@VE.SoftNorms.Tree VE.SoftNorms.Outranking.holistic@VE.SoftNorms.Tree VE.SoftNorms.Outranking@VE.SoftNorms.Tree VE.SoftNorms.SoftDoc.T@VE.SoftNorms.Tree VE.SoftNorms.SoftDoc.soft@VE.SoftNorms.Tree VE.SoftNorms.SoftEnv.outranking@VE.SoftNorms.Tree VE.SoftNorms.SoftNode.mode@VE.SoftNorms.Tree VE.SoftNorms.SoftNode@VE.SoftNorms.Tree VE.SoftNorms.SoftTree.nodes@VE.SoftNorms.Tree VE.SoftNorms.act@VE.SoftNorms.Tree VE.SoftNorms.higher@VE.SoftNorms.Tree VE.SoftNorms.outweighsTriples@VE.SoftNorms.Tree VE.SoftNorms.rk@VE.SoftNorms.Tree

theorem VE.Readings.pairEval_id
  ∀ {α : Type} [inst : DecidableEq α] (D : VE.Readings.Doc) (s : String) (i j : Nat) (σ : VE.Readings.Situation α),
    VE.Readings.cells D s j σ.base ≤ VE.Readings.maxCells →
      VE.Readings.pairEval (Pure.pure ()) (Pure.pure ()) D s i j (VE.Readings.sideOf D s i) (VE.Readings.sideOf D s j) σ =
        (VE.Readings.separates D s i j σ,
          VE.Readings.sideValid D s i σ.base (VE.Readings.tablesFor D s i (σ.fixed ++ σ.decisions)),
          VE.Readings.sideValue D s i σ.base (VE.Readings.tablesFor D s i (σ.fixed ++ σ.decisions)) σ.probe,
          (VE.Readings.assignments D s j σ.base).any fun G =>
            VE.Readings.sideValid D s j σ.base (VE.Readings.tablesFor D s j σ.fixed ++ G),
          if VE.Readings.ownedKeys D s j = [] then
            VE.Readings.sideValue D s j σ.base (VE.Readings.tablesFor D s j σ.fixed) σ.probe
          else Option.none)
  -- uses VE.Readings.Doc@VE.Readings.Doc VE.Readings.GenKey@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Readings.Situation.base@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Readings.Situation.decisions@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Readings.Situation.fixed@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Readings.Situation.probe@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Readings.Situation@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Readings.assignments@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Readings.cells@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Readings.instDecidableEqGenKey@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Readings.maxCells@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Readings.ownedKeys@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Readings.pairEval@VE.Readings.Scan VE.Readings.separates@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Readings.sideOf@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Readings.sideValid@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Readings.sideValue@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Readings.tablesFor@VE.Readings.Separate

theorem VE.Readings.pull_canon
  ∀ {D : VE.Readings.Doc},
    VE.Readings.Hyps D →
      ∀ {c : VE.Readings.Choice},
        VE.Readings.Compatible D c →
          ∀ (B : VE.Structure),
            (∀ (x s : String),
                (VE.SoftNorms.soften (VE.Readings.sup D).fst.soft).E.constants x = Option.some s →
                  ∃ v, B.constant x = Option.some v) →
              VE.Readings.Encodes D c B →
                ∀ {p : String} {ss : List String},
                  (VE.SoftNorms.envPrime (VE.Readings.choiceDoc D c).fst.soft).predicates p = Option.some ss →
                    ∀ (ws : List B.Carrier),
                      ws.length = ss.length →
                        ((VE.Readings.pull D c
                                (VE.SoftNorms.canon (VE.SoftNorms.soften (VE.Readings.sup D).fst.soft) B)).relation
                            p ws ↔

theorem VE.Readings.quiet_iff
  ∀ {Xs Xd : VE.Rights.RightsDoc} {As Ad : List VE.Formula} {oi oj : VE.Readings.GenKey → Bool} {k₀ : VE.Readings.GenKey}
    {e : String} {E : VE.Environment} (B : VE.Structure) (F : VE.Readings.Tables B.Carrier)
    (q : VE.Readings.Probe B.Carrier) (v : Bool),
    (∀ (k : VE.Readings.GenKey), oi k = oj k) →
      oj k₀ = Bool.true →
        (B.Admissible E → ∀ (vs : List B.Carrier), ¬B.relation e vs) →
          ((∀ (vs : List B.Carrier), ¬B.relation e vs) →
              ∀ (G H : VE.Readings.Tables B.Carrier),
                (∀ (k : VE.Readings.GenKey), k ≠ k₀ → ∀ (vs : List B.Carrier), G k vs ↔ H k vs) →
                  (∀ (vs : List B.Carrier), ¬H k₀ vs) → VE.Readings.tablesRel Xs B G = VE.Readings.tablesRel Xd B H) →
            ((∀ (vs : List B.Carrier), ¬B.relation e vs) →
                ∀ (G : VE.Readings.Tables B.Carrier),
                  VE.Rights.BaseAdmissibleR Xs (VE.Readings.withTables Xs B G) ∧
                      VE.Readings.Observes Xs As (VE.Readings.withTables Xs B G) q v ↔
                    VE.Rights.BaseAdmissibleR Xd (VE.Readings.withTables Xs B G) ∧
                      VE.Readings.Observes Xd Ad (VE.Readings.withTables Xs B G) q v) →
              ((B.Admissible E ∧
                  ∃ G,
                    (∀ (k : VE.Readings.GenKey), oi k = Bool.false → ∀ (vs : List B.Carrier), G k vs ↔ F k vs) ∧
                      VE.Rights.BaseAdmissibleR Xs (VE.Readings.withTables Xs B G) ∧
                        VE.Readings.Observes Xs As (VE.Readings.withTables Xs B G) q v) ↔
                B.Admissible E ∧
                  ∃ G,
                    (∀ (k : VE.Readings.GenKey), oj k = Bool.false → ∀ (vs : List B.Carrier), G k vs ↔ F k vs) ∧
                      (∀ (vs : List B.Carrier), ¬G k₀ vs) ∧
                        VE.Rights.BaseAdmissibleR Xd (VE.Readings.withTables Xd B G) ∧
                          VE.Readings.Observes Xd Ad (VE.Readings.withTables Xd B G) q v)
  -- uses VE.Environment@VE.Syntax VE.Formula@VE.Syntax VE.Readings.GenKey@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Readings.Observes@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Readings.Probe@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Readings.Tables@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Readings.tablesRel@VE.Readings.Force VE.Readings.withTables@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Rights.BaseAdmissibleR@VE.Rights.Correlate VE.Rights.RightsDoc@VE.Rights.Tree VE.Structure.Admissible@VE.Semantics VE.Structure.Carrier@VE.Semantics VE.Structure.relation@VE.Semantics VE.Structure@VE.Semantics

                      (VE.SoftNorms.SelectsSoftD C (VE.SoftNorms.canon (VE.SoftNorms.soften C) S) (VE.Norms.tupleVal vs)

                        VE.SoftNorms.SelectsSoftD (VE.Readings.relaxDoc C Nd)
                          (VE.SoftNorms.canon (VE.SoftNorms.soften (VE.Readings.relaxDoc C Nd)) S) (VE.Norms.tupleVal vs)
                          (VE.SoftNorms.fuel (VE.Readings.relaxDoc C Nd)) (VE.Readings.relaxTo Nd N))

theorem VE.Readings.separates_noKeys
  ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : DecidableEq α] (D : VE.Readings.Doc) (s : String) (i j : Nat) (M : VE.FiniteModel α)
    (F : List (VE.Readings.GenKey × List (List α))) (q : VE.Readings.Probe α) (v : Bool),
    VE.Readings.ownedKeys D s j = [] →
      (∀ (t : VE.Readings.GenKey × List (List α)),
          t ∈ F →
            VE.Readings.owned D s i t.fst = Bool.false ∧
              VE.Readings.owned D s j t.fst = Bool.false ∧
                (((VE.Readings.genKeys (VE.Readings.one D s i).fst).any fun x => x.fst == t.fst) ||
                    (VE.Readings.genKeys (VE.Readings.one D s j).fst).any fun x => x.fst == t.fst) =
                  Bool.true) →
        (List.map (fun x => x.fst) F).Nodup →
          q ∈ VE.Readings.probesOf D M →
            VE.Readings.sideValid D s i M (VE.Readings.tablesFor D s i F) = Bool.true →
              VE.Readings.sideValid D s j M (VE.Readings.tablesFor D s j F) = Bool.true →
                (VE.Readings.separates D s i j { base := M, fixed := F, decisions := [], probe := q, value := v } =
                    Bool.true ↔
                  VE.Readings.sideValue D s i M (VE.Readings.tablesFor D s i F) q = Option.some v ∧
                    VE.Readings.sideValue D s j M (VE.Readings.tablesFor D s j F) q ≠ Option.some v)
  -- uses VE.FiniteModel@VE.Finite VE.Formula@VE.Syntax VE.Readings.Doc@VE.Readings.Doc VE.Readings.GenKey@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Readings.Probe@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Readings.Situation.mk@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Readings.genKeys@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Readings.instDecidableEqGenKey@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Readings.one@VE.Readings.Doc VE.Readings.owned@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Readings.ownedKeys@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Readings.probesOf@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Readings.separates@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Readings.sideValid@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Readings.sideValue@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Readings.tablesFor@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Rights.RightsDoc@VE.Rights.Tree

theorem VE.Readings.separates_other
  ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : DecidableEq α] (D : VE.Readings.Doc),
    VE.Readings.WellFormedDoc D = Bool.true →

        ((VE.Readings.candidate D s j).bind fun x => x.content) ≠ Option.none →

                  VE.Readings.probeTyped (VE.Readings.one D s i).fst σ.base σ.probe = Bool.true →
                    (∀ (G : List (VE.Readings.GenKey × List (List α))),
                        G ∈ VE.Readings.assignments D s j σ.base →
                          (VE.Readings.sideValid D s j σ.base (VE.Readings.tablesFor D s j σ.fixed ++ G) &&
                              VE.Readings.sideValue D s j σ.base (VE.Readings.tablesFor D s j σ.fixed ++ G) σ.probe ==
                                Option.some σ.value) =
                            Bool.false) →
                      ¬VE.Readings.Achieves D s j σ.base.asStructure (VE.Readings.tablesOf σ.fixed) σ.probe σ.value

theorem VE.Readings.separation_conservative
  ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : DecidableEq α] (D : VE.Readings.Doc) (s : String) (i j : Nat) (M : VE.FiniteModel α)
    (F : List (VE.Readings.GenKey × List (List α))),
    VE.Readings.ownedKeys D s i = [] →
      VE.Readings.ownedKeys D s j = [] →
        (∀ (t : VE.Readings.GenKey × List (List α)),
            t ∈ F →
              VE.Readings.owned D s i t.fst = Bool.false ∧
                VE.Readings.owned D s j t.fst = Bool.false ∧
                  (((VE.Readings.genKeys (VE.Readings.one D s i).fst).any fun x => x.fst == t.fst) ||
                      (VE.Readings.genKeys (VE.Readings.one D s j).fst).any fun x => x.fst == t.fst) =
                    Bool.true) →
          (List.map (fun x => x.fst) F).Nodup →
            VE.Readings.sideValid D s i M (VE.Readings.tablesFor D s i F) = Bool.true →
              VE.Readings.sideValid D s j M (VE.Readings.tablesFor D s j F) = Bool.true →
                ((∃ q,
                    q ∈ VE.Readings.probesOf D M ∧
                      ∃ v,
                        VE.Readings.separates D s i j { base := M, fixed := F, decisions := [], probe := q, value := v } =
                            Bool.true ∨
                          VE.Readings.separates D s j i
                              { base := M, fixed := F, decisions := [], probe := q, value := v } =
                            Bool.true) ↔
                  VE.Readings.observeAll D s i M F ≠ VE.Readings.observeAll D s j M F)
  -- uses VE.FiniteModel@VE.Finite VE.Formula@VE.Syntax VE.Readings.Doc@VE.Readings.Doc VE.Readings.GenKey@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Readings.Probe@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Readings.Situation.mk@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Readings.genKeys@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Readings.instDecidableEqGenKey@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Readings.observeAll@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Readings.one@VE.Readings.Doc VE.Readings.owned@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Readings.ownedKeys@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Readings.probesOf@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Readings.separates@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Readings.sideValid@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Readings.tablesFor@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Rights.RightsDoc@VE.Rights.Tree

theorem VE.Readings.sim_applies
  ∀ {X Y : VE.SoftNorms.SoftDoc} {f : VE.SoftNorms.SoftNode → VE.SoftNorms.SoftNode} {S : VE.Structure}
    {R' : String → List S.Carrier → Prop} {ρ : VE.Valuation S},

theorem VE.Readings.slot_wellFormed
  ∀ (D : VE.Readings.Doc),
    VE.Readings.WellFormedDoc D = Bool.true →
      D.chain ≠ VE.Readings.Chain.rights →
        VE.Readings.superposable D = Bool.true →
          ∀ (A : VE.Readings.Choice),

theorem VE.Readings.soften_build_fillDoc
  ∀ (N : VE.Readings.NDoc),
    VE.Readings.normsShaped N.D = Bool.true →
      ∀ (keep keep' : String → Bool) (pick pick' : VE.Readings.ReadingSet → Option VE.Readings.Candidate),
        (∀ (R : VE.Readings.ReadingSet) (a : VE.Readings.Candidate), pick R = Option.some a → a ∈ R.candidates) →
          (∀ (u : String), keep' u = keep u) →
            (∀ (R : VE.Readings.ReadingSet),
                VE.Readings.Item.set R ∈ N.D.items →
                  pick' (VE.Readings.fillSet N R) = Option.map (VE.Readings.fillCand N) (pick R)) →
              (∀ (r : VE.Norms.Regulated),
                  r ∈ N.D.frame.soft.T.regulated →
                    r.name ∈ N.unspec → keep' (VE.NormDefaults.fillName r.name) = Bool.true) →
                VE.SoftNorms.soften (VE.Rights.correlate (VE.Readings.build (VE.Readings.fillDoc N) keep' pick').fst) =
                    VE.NormDefaults.fill
                      { D := VE.SoftNorms.soften (VE.Rights.correlate (VE.Readings.build N.D keep pick).fst),
                        unspec := N.unspec } ∧
                  (VE.Readings.build (VE.Readings.fillDoc N) keep' pick').snd = (VE.Readings.build N.D keep pick).snd
  -- uses VE.Formula@VE.Syntax VE.NormDefaults.UDoc.mk@VE.NormDefaults.Tree VE.NormDefaults.fill@VE.NormDefaults.Tree VE.NormDefaults.fillName@VE.NormDefaults.Tree VE.Norms.Doc@VE.Norms.Tree VE.Norms.Regulated.name@VE.Norms.Tree VE.Norms.Regulated@VE.Norms.Tree VE.Readings.Candidate@VE.Readings.Doc VE.Readings.Doc.frame@VE.Readings.Doc VE.Readings.Doc.items@VE.Readings.Doc VE.Readings.Item.set@VE.Readings.Doc VE.Readings.Item@VE.Readings.Doc VE.Readings.NDoc.D@VE.Readings.Unspecified VE.Readings.NDoc.unspec@VE.Readings.Unspecified VE.Readings.NDoc@VE.Readings.Unspecified VE.Readings.ReadingSet.candidates@VE.Readings.Doc VE.Readings.ReadingSet@VE.Readings.Doc VE.Readings.build@VE.Readings.Doc VE.Readings.fillCand@VE.Readings.Unspecified VE.Readings.fillDoc@VE.Readings.Unspecified VE.Readings.fillSet@VE.Readings.Unspecified VE.Readings.normsShaped@VE.Readings.Unspecified VE.Rights.RightsDoc.soft@VE.Rights.Tree VE.Rights.RightsDoc@VE.Rights.Tree VE.Rights.correlate@VE.Rights.Correlate VE.SoftNorms.SoftDoc.T@VE.SoftNorms.Tree VE.SoftNorms.SoftTree.regulated@VE.SoftNorms.Tree VE.SoftNorms.soften@VE.SoftNorms.Soften

theorem VE.Readings.split_dunder
  ∀ (k k' p p' : List Char),
    (∀ (u v : List Char), p ≠ u ++ '_' :: '_' :: v) →
      (∀ (u v : List Char), p' ≠ u ++ '_' :: '_' :: v) →
        p.head? ≠ Option.some '_' →
          p'.head? ≠ Option.some '_' → k ++ '_' :: '_' :: p = k' ++ '_' :: '_' :: p' → k = k' ∧ p = p'

theorem VE.Readings.strictYields_stable
  ∀ (D : VE.SoftNorms.SoftDoc) (S : VE.Structure) (ρ : VE.Valuation S) (r : VE.SoftNorms.SoftNode → Nat),
    (∀ (N : VE.SoftNorms.SoftNode),
        N ∈ D.T.nodes → ∀ (C : VE.SoftNorms.SoftNode), C ∈ VE.SoftNorms.children D N → r C < r N) →

  ∀ (D : VE.Readings.Doc) (m : Nat) (R : VE.Readings.ReadingSet) (is : List Nat)
    (acc : VE.Rights.RightsDoc × List VE.Formula),
    VE.Readings.Grows acc.fst

theorem VE.Readings.superpose_assertions
  ∀ (D : VE.Readings.Doc),
    VE.Readings.WellFormedDoc D = Bool.true →

          D.couplings = [] ∧ D.narrowings = [] →
            ∀ (S : VE.Structure),
              Nonempty S.Carrier →
                ((∃ S',

                  VE.Norms.Sat S (VE.Readings.free D).snd ∧

                      R ∈ D.sets →
                        ∃ a,
                          a ∈ R.candidates ∧
                            ∃ φ, a.content = Option.some (VE.Compose.Content.assertion φ) ∧ VE.Formula.denote S [] φ)

theorem VE.Readings.superpose_conflict_witness
  ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : DecidableEq α] (D : VE.Readings.Doc),
    VE.Readings.WellFormedDoc D = Bool.true →
      D.chain ≠ VE.Readings.Chain.rights →
        VE.Readings.superposable D = Bool.true →
          ∀ (A : VE.Readings.Choice) (t : String × List String × VE.Formula),
            t ∈ VE.Norms.targets (VE.SoftNorms.soften (VE.Rights.correlate (VE.Readings.sup D).fst)) →
              ∀ (M : VE.FiniteModel α),
                M.Valid (VE.Norms.envAt (VE.SoftNorms.soften (VE.Rights.correlate (VE.Readings.sup D).fst)) 0) →
                  VE.Compose.backgroundValidP (VE.Rights.correlate (VE.Readings.sup D).fst) (VE.Readings.slotUnder D A)
                        M =
                      Bool.true →
                    ∀ (vs : List α),
                      VE.TupleTyped M.asStructure t.snd.fst vs →
                        VE.Formula.eval M (VE.Norms.tupleVal vs) t.snd.snd = Bool.true →
                          ∃ c,
                            VE.Readings.Compatible D c ∧
                              (∀ (x : String × Nat), x ∈ A → x ∈ c) ∧
                                VE.Readings.Encodes D c M.asStructure ∧
                                  VE.Rights.BaseAdmissibleR (VE.Readings.choiceDoc D c).fst
                                      (VE.Readings.pull D c M.asStructure) ∧
                                    ¬VE.Norms.ConflictFree

theorem VE.Readings.superpose_countermodel
  ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : DecidableEq α] (D : VE.Readings.Doc),
    VE.Readings.WellFormedDoc D = Bool.true →
      D.chain ≠ VE.Readings.Chain.rights →
        VE.Readings.superposable D = Bool.true →
          ∀ (A : VE.Readings.Choice) (Γ : List VE.Formula) (φ : VE.Formula),
            (∀ (a : VE.Formula), a ∈ Γ → VE.Formula.WellFormed (VE.Readings.sharedEnv D) [] a) →
              VE.Formula.WellFormed (VE.Readings.sharedEnv D) [] φ →
                ∀ (M : VE.FiniteModel α),
                  M.Valid (VE.Norms.envAt (VE.SoftNorms.soften (VE.Rights.correlate (VE.Readings.sup D).fst)) 0) →
                    VE.Readings.supModelCheck D A Γ M = Bool.true →
                      VE.Formula.eval M [] (VE.SoftNorms.circ (VE.Rights.correlate (VE.Readings.sup D).fst) φ) =
                          Bool.false →
                        ∃ c,
                          VE.Readings.Compatible D c ∧
                            (∀ (x : String × Nat), x ∈ A → x ∈ c) ∧
                              VE.Readings.Encodes D c M.asStructure ∧
                                VE.Rights.BaseAdmissibleR (VE.Readings.choiceDoc D c).fst
                                    (VE.Readings.pull D c M.asStructure) ∧
                                  VE.Norms.Sat
                                      (VE.Readings.expand (VE.Readings.choiceDoc D c).fst
                                        (VE.Readings.pull D c M.asStructure))
                                      ((VE.Readings.choiceDoc D c).snd ++ Γ) ∧
                                    ¬VE.Formula.denote
                                        (VE.Readings.expand (VE.Readings.choiceDoc D c).fst
                                          (VE.Readings.pull D c M.asStructure))
                                        [] φ
  -- uses VE.FiniteModel.Valid@VE.Finite VE.FiniteModel.asStructure@VE.Finite VE.FiniteModel@VE.Finite VE.Formula.WellFormed@VE.Syntax VE.Formula.denote@VE.Semantics VE.Formula.eval@VE.Finite VE.Formula@VE.Syntax VE.Norms.Sat@VE.Norms.Prefix VE.Norms.envAt@VE.Norms.Tree VE.Readings.Chain.rights@VE.Readings.Doc VE.Readings.Chain@VE.Readings.Doc VE.Readings.Choice@VE.Readings.Choice VE.Readings.Compatible@VE.Readings.Choice VE.Readings.Doc.chain@VE.Readings.Doc VE.Readings.Doc@VE.Readings.Doc VE.Readings.Encodes@VE.Readings.Choice VE.Readings.WellFormedDoc@VE.Readings.Doc VE.Readings.choiceDoc@VE.Readings.Choice VE.Readings.expand@VE.Readings.Separate VE.Readings.pull@VE.Readings.Choice VE.Readings.sharedEnv@VE.Readings.Choice VE.Readings.sup@VE.Readings.Choice VE.Readings.supModelCheck@VE.Readings.Route VE.Readings.superposable@VE.Readings.Choice VE.Rights.BaseAdmissibleR@VE.Rights.Correlate VE.Rights.RightsDoc@VE.Rights.Tree VE.Rights.correlate@VE.Rights.Correlate VE.SoftNorms.circ@VE.SoftNorms.Semantics VE.SoftNorms.soften@VE.SoftNorms.Soften VE.Structure.Carrier@VE.Semantics

theorem VE.Readings.tablesModel_rel
  ∀ {α : Type u} (X : VE.Rights.RightsDoc) (M : VE.FiniteModel α) (T : List (VE.Readings.GenKey × List (List α)))
    (G : VE.Readings.Tables α),
    (∀ (p : String) (g : VE.Readings.GenKey × String × List String),
        List.find? (fun x => x.snd.fst == p) (VE.Readings.genKeys X) = Option.some g →
          ∀ (vs : List α), vs ∈ VE.Readings.tableOf T g.fst ↔ G g.fst vs) →
      (fun p vs => vs ∈ (VE.Readings.tablesModel X M T).relations p) = fun p vs =>

        | Option.some g => G g.fst vs

  ∀ {α : Type} (b : Nat) (xs ys : List α) (f : Nat → List α),
    (∀ (n : Nat), n ≠ 0 → f n = List.take n ys) →
      (if b ≤ (List.take b xs).length then List.take b xs else List.take b xs ++ f (b - (List.take b xs).length)) =
        List.take b (xs ++ ys)

theorem VE.Readings.uniformPrecedence_spec
  ∀ (D : VE.Readings.Doc),
    VE.Readings.uniformPrecedence D = Bool.true ↔
      ∀ (u : String) (c : VE.Compose.Content) (cs : List (String × List String)),
        VE.Readings.Item.fixed u c cs ∈ D.items →
          ∀ (N : VE.SoftNorms.SoftNode),
            c = VE.Compose.Content.norm N →
              ∀ (n : String),
                n ∈ N.over →
                  ∀ (R : VE.Readings.ReadingSet),
                    R ∈ D.sets →
                      ("rule", n) ∈ VE.Readings.interfaceOf R →
                        ∀ (a : VE.Readings.Candidate),
                          a ∈ R.candidates →
                            ∀ (b : VE.Readings.Candidate),
                              b ∈ R.candidates →
                                ∀ (Na Nb : VE.SoftNorms.SoftNode),
                                  (a.content.bind fun x => VE.Readings.ruleNamed x n) = Option.some Na →
                                    (b.content.bind fun x => VE.Readings.ruleNamed x n) = Option.some Nb →
                                      ∀ (m : String), m ∈ Na.over ↔ m ∈ Nb.over
  -- uses VE.Compose.Content.norm@VE.Compose.Content VE.Compose.Content@VE.Compose.Content VE.Norms.Node.over@VE.Norms.Tree VE.Readings.Candidate.content@VE.Readings.Doc VE.Readings.Candidate@VE.Readings.Doc VE.Readings.Doc.items@VE.Readings.Doc VE.Readings.Doc.sets@VE.Readings.Doc VE.Readings.Doc@VE.Readings.Doc VE.Readings.Item.fixed@VE.Readings.Doc VE.Readings.Item@VE.Readings.Doc VE.Readings.ReadingSet.candidates@VE.Readings.Doc VE.Readings.ReadingSet@VE.Readings.Doc VE.Readings.interfaceOf@VE.Readings.Doc VE.Readings.ruleNamed@VE.Readings.Choice VE.Readings.uniformPrecedence@VE.Readings.Choice VE.SoftNorms.SoftNode.toNode@VE.SoftNorms.Tree VE.SoftNorms.SoftNode@VE.SoftNorms.Tree

theorem VE.Readings.value_sim
  ∀ {X Y : VE.SoftNorms.SoftDoc} {f : VE.SoftNorms.SoftNode → VE.SoftNorms.SoftNode} {S : VE.Structure}
    {R' : String → List S.Carrier → Prop} (r : VE.Norms.Regulated) (vs : List S.Carrier),
    VE.Readings.Sim X Y f S R' (VE.Norms.tupleVal vs) →

        u ∈ D.units →

                ¬{ act := VE.Reports.Act.believes, sort := s₂, ctx := c',
                        content := VE.Reports.complementId D (VE.Reports.Content.formula q) Option.none } ∈
                      VE.Reports.topKeys D →
                  ∀ (S₀ : VE.Structure),
                    S₀.Admissible D.E →
                      VE.Reports.Expandable D S₀ →

                          ∃ M,

                                VE.Route.Admission.CitationsClosed (VE.Reports.w2Doc res.D) res.report ∧
                                  VE.Route.Admission.ChoicesCompatible res.report

                  VE.Reports.unitPremise D u =
                    Option.some
                      (VE.Formula.unary
                        (VE.Reports.reportName D
                          { act := act, sort := s, ctx := c, content := VE.Reports.complementId D b lit })
                        (VE.Term.const h))) ∨
            (∃ j a b r,
                u.content = VE.Reports.Content.assessment j a b ∧
                  VE.Reports.recordOf D a = Option.some r ∧
                    VE.Reports.unitPremise D u =
                      Option.some
                        (VE.Formula.unary
                          (VE.Reports.assessName D { j := j, a := a, content := VE.Reports.contentId D b })
                          (VE.Term.const r.context))) ∨
              (∃ h act c b lit s,
                  u.content = (VE.Reports.Content.report h act c b lit).negated ∧
                    VE.Reports.holderSort D h = Option.some s ∧
                      VE.Reports.unitPremise D u =
                        Option.some
                          (VE.Formula.unary
                              (VE.Reports.reportName D
                                { act := act, sort := s, ctx := c, content := VE.Reports.complementId D b lit })
                              (VE.Term.const h)).not) ∨
                ∃ j a b r,
                  u.content = (VE.Reports.Content.assessment j a b).negated ∧
                    VE.Reports.recordOf D a = Option.some r ∧
                      VE.Reports.unitPremise D u =
                        Option.some
                          (VE.Formula.unary
                              (VE.Reports.assessName D { j := j, a := a, content := VE.Reports.contentId D b })
                              (VE.Term.const r.context)).not
  -- uses VE.Formula.not@VE.Syntax VE.Formula.unary@VE.Syntax VE.Formula@VE.Syntax VE.Reports.Act@VE.Attribution.Content VE.Reports.AssessKey.mk@VE.Attribution.Content VE.Reports.Assessment.context@VE.Attribution.Content VE.Reports.Assessment@VE.Attribution.Content VE.Reports.Content.assessment@VE.Attribution.Content VE.Reports.Content.negated@VE.Attribution.Content VE.Reports.Content.report@VE.Attribution.Content VE.Reports.Content@VE.Attribution.Content VE.Reports.Judgment@VE.Attribution.Content VE.Reports.ReportDoc.units@VE.Attribution.Content VE.Reports.ReportDoc@VE.Attribution.Content VE.Reports.ReportKey.mk@VE.Attribution.Content VE.Reports.Unit.content@VE.Attribution.Content VE.Reports.Unit@VE.Attribution.Content VE.Reports.WF@VE.Attribution.Facts VE.Reports.assessName@VE.Attribution.Content VE.Reports.complementId@VE.Attribution.Content VE.Reports.contentId@VE.Attribution.Content VE.Reports.holderSort@VE.Attribution.Content VE.Reports.recordOf@VE.Attribution.Content VE.Reports.reportName@VE.Attribution.Content VE.Reports.unitPremise@VE.Attribution.Content VE.Term.const@VE.Syntax

theorem VE.Rights.correlate_identity
  ∀ (D : VE.Rights.RightsDoc),
    VE.Rights.WellFormedRights D = Bool.true →
      D.limits = [] ∧
          (∀ (R : VE.Rights.Right),
              R ∈ D.rs → ∀ (N : VE.Rights.SourceLine), N ∈ R.lines → N.kind ≠ VE.Rights.Kind.power ∧ N.fanOut = []) ∧

        (VE.Rights.correlate D).E = D.soft.E ∧
          (VE.Rights.correlate D).T.nodes =

                  { name := __src.name, pred := __src.pred, sign := __src.sign,
                    guard := VE.Rights.holderConj D RN.snd RN.snd.node.guard, carveOuts := __src.carveOuts,
                    over := __src.over, mode := __src.mode, rank := __src.rank, alterable := __src.alterable,
                    exception := __src.exception, hard := __src.hard })
                (VE.Rights.linesOf D) ++
              D.soft.T.nodes

theorem VE.Rights.licensed_certified_sound
  ∀ (D : VE.Rights.RightsDoc),
    VE.Rights.WellFormedRights D = Bool.true →
      ∀ (N : VE.Rights.Line) (n : VE.Rights.Narrowing) (c : VE.Tableau.Certificate),
        VE.Tableau.checkCertificate (VE.Norms.envAt (VE.SoftNorms.soften (VE.Rights.correlate D)) 0)
              (VE.Rights.backgroundBaseR D)
              (VE.Norms.bindAll (VE.Rights.sortsOf D N)
                ((VE.Rights.outcomeSubst D (VE.Rights.condF D N n)).implies (VE.Rights.limPack D N)))
              c =
            Bool.true →
          ∀ (B : VE.Structure),
            VE.Rights.BaseAdmissibleR D B →
              ∀ (vs : List B.Carrier),
                VE.TupleTyped B (VE.Rights.sortsOf D N) vs →
                  VE.Formula.denote B (VE.Norms.tupleVal vs) (VE.Rights.outcomeSubst D (VE.Rights.condF D N n)) →
                    VE.Formula.denote B (VE.Norms.tupleVal vs) (VE.Rights.limPack D N)
  -- uses VE.Formula.denote@VE.Semantics VE.Formula.implies@VE.Syntax VE.Norms.bindAll@VE.Norms.Basic VE.Norms.envAt@VE.Norms.Tree VE.Norms.tupleVal@VE.Norms.Basic VE.Rights.BaseAdmissibleR@VE.Rights.Correlate VE.Rights.Line@VE.Rights.Tree VE.Rights.Narrowing@VE.Rights.Correlate VE.Rights.RightsDoc@VE.Rights.Tree VE.Rights.WellFormedRights@VE.Rights.Correlate VE.Rights.backgroundBaseR@VE.Rights.Correlate VE.Rights.condF@VE.Rights.Correlate VE.Rights.correlate@VE.Rights.Correlate VE.Rights.limPack@VE.Rights.Correlate VE.Rights.outcomeSubst@VE.Rights.Correlate VE.Rights.sortsOf@VE.Rights.Tree VE.SoftNorms.soften@VE.SoftNorms.Soften VE.Structure.Carrier@VE.Semantics VE.Structure@VE.Semantics VE.Tableau.Certificate@VE.Tableau VE.Tableau.checkCertificate@VE.TableauChecker VE.TupleTyped@VE.Semantics

theorem VE.Rights.limitation_scope_sound
  ∀ (D : VE.Rights.RightsDoc),
    VE.Rights.WellFormedRights D = Bool.true →
      ∀ (certs : List (Option VE.Tableau.Certificate)),
        VE.Rights.limitationScope D certs = [] →
          ∀ (L : VE.Rights.Limitation),
            L ∈ D.limits →
              ∀ (R : String) (N : VE.Rights.Line),
                (R, N) ∈ VE.Rights.linesOf D →
                  VE.Rights.inScope D L R N = Bool.true →
                    ∀ (B : VE.Structure),
                      VE.Rights.BaseAdmissibleR D B →
                        ∀ (vs : List B.Carrier),
                          VE.TupleTyped B (VE.Rights.sortsOf D N) vs →
                            VE.Formula.denote B (VE.Norms.tupleVal vs)
                                (VE.Rights.outcomeSubst D (VE.Rights.ownGuard D N)) →
                              ¬VE.Formula.denote B (VE.Norms.tupleVal vs)
                                    (VE.Rights.outcomeSubst D (VE.Rights.selectsR D N)) →
                                VE.Formula.denote B (VE.Norms.tupleVal vs) (VE.Rights.limPack D N) ∨
                                  (∃ n,
                                      n ∈ VE.Rights.narrowings D N ∧
                                        VE.Rights.cited D N n = Bool.true ∧
                                          VE.Formula.denote B (VE.Norms.tupleVal vs)
                                            (VE.Rights.outcomeSubst D (VE.Rights.condF D N n))) ∨
                                    (∃ n,
                                        n ∈ VE.Rights.narrowings D N ∧
                                          VE.Rights.rightCollision D N n = Bool.true ∧
                                            VE.Formula.denote B (VE.Norms.tupleVal vs)
                                              (VE.Rights.outcomeSubst D (VE.Rights.condF D N n))) ∨
                                      (∃ M,
                                          VE.Rights.sameEffectStrict D N M = Bool.true ∧
                                            VE.Formula.denote B (VE.Norms.tupleVal vs)
                                              (VE.Rights.outcomeSubst D
                                                (VE.Rights.condF D N (VE.Rights.Narrowing.blockedBy M)))) ∨
                                        VE.Rights.ruleReading D = Bool.true ∧
                                          ∃ m,
                                            VE.Rights.barReach D N = Option.some m ∧
                                              VE.Formula.denote B (VE.Norms.tupleVal vs) (VE.Rights.aimedF D m)
  -- uses VE.Formula.denote@VE.Semantics VE.Norms.tupleVal@VE.Norms.Basic VE.Rights.BaseAdmissibleR@VE.Rights.Correlate VE.Rights.Finding@VE.Rights.Scope VE.Rights.Limitation@VE.Rights.Tree VE.Rights.Line@VE.Rights.Tree VE.Rights.Narrowing.blockedBy@VE.Rights.Correlate VE.Rights.Narrowing@VE.Rights.Correlate VE.Rights.RightsDoc.limits@VE.Rights.Tree VE.Rights.RightsDoc@VE.Rights.Tree VE.Rights.WellFormedRights@VE.Rights.Correlate VE.Rights.aimedF@VE.Rights.Correlate VE.Rights.barReach@VE.Rights.Correlate VE.Rights.cited@VE.Rights.Scope VE.Rights.condF@VE.Rights.Correlate VE.Rights.inScope@VE.Rights.Tree VE.Rights.limPack@VE.Rights.Correlate VE.Rights.limitationScope@VE.Rights.Scope VE.Rights.linesOf@VE.Rights.Tree VE.Rights.narrowings@VE.Rights.Correlate VE.Rights.outcomeSubst@VE.Rights.Correlate VE.Rights.ownGuard@VE.Rights.Correlate VE.Rights.rightCollision@VE.Rights.Scope VE.Rights.ruleReading@VE.Rights.Tree VE.Rights.sameEffectStrict@VE.Rights.Scope VE.Rights.selectsR@VE.Rights.Correlate VE.Rights.sortsOf@VE.Rights.Tree VE.Structure.Carrier@VE.Semantics VE.Structure@VE.Semantics VE.Tableau.Certificate@VE.Tableau VE.TupleTyped@VE.Semantics

theorem VE.Rights.rights_conflict_witness_sound
  ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : DecidableEq α] (D : VE.Rights.RightsDoc),
    VE.Rights.WellFormedRights D = Bool.true →
      ∀ (t : String × List String × VE.Formula),
        t ∈ VE.Norms.targets (VE.SoftNorms.soften (VE.Rights.correlate D)) →
          ∀ (M : VE.FiniteModel α),
            M.Valid (VE.Norms.envAt (VE.SoftNorms.soften (VE.Rights.correlate D)) 0) →
              VE.Rights.backgroundValidR D M = Bool.true →
                ∀ (vs : List α),
                  VE.TupleTyped M.asStructure t.snd.fst vs →
                    VE.Formula.eval M (VE.Norms.tupleVal vs) t.snd.snd = Bool.true →
                      ¬VE.Norms.ConflictFree (VE.SoftNorms.soften (VE.Rights.correlate D)) M.asStructure ∧

theorem VE.Risk.combine_GS
  ∀ {x : Int} {W : List Int},
    VE.Risk.Gap x W →
      ∀ (comb : Option VE.Risk.Combination) (Fq : List (Int → VE.Risk.Estimate)),
        Fq ≠ [] →
          (∀ (f : Int → VE.Risk.Estimate), f ∈ Fq → VE.Risk.SeqConst f) →
            (∀ (f : Int → VE.Risk.Estimate), f ∈ Fq → VE.Risk.GS x W fun y => (f y).lo) →
              (∀ (f : Int → VE.Risk.Estimate), f ∈ Fq → VE.Risk.GS x W fun y => (f y).hi) →
                (VE.Risk.GS x W fun y => (VE.Risk.combineRange comb (List.map (fun x => x y) Fq)).fst) ∧
                  VE.Risk.GS x W fun y => (VE.Risk.combineRange comb (List.map (fun x => x y) Fq)).snd
  -- uses VE.Risk.Combination@VE.Risk.Decl VE.Risk.Estimate.hi@VE.Risk.Record VE.Risk.Estimate.lo@VE.Risk.Record VE.Risk.Estimate@VE.Risk.Record VE.Risk.GS@VE.Risk.Piecewise VE.Risk.Gap@VE.Risk.Piecewise VE.Risk.SeqConst@VE.Risk.Piecewise VE.Risk.combineRange@VE.Risk.Record

            (VE.Risk.combineRange comb (List.map (fun x => x y') Fq)).snd)

theorem VE.Risk.combine_ok
  ∀ {b : VE.Risk.Box} {x y : VE.Risk.Cond} {va vb : VE.Risk.Valuation},
    VE.Risk.InBox b va →
      VE.Risk.InBox b vb →
        ((x.atomNames ++ y.atomNames).all fun q =>

              (∀ (q : String), q ∈ x.atomNames → VE.Risk.combine x va vb q = va q) ∧

theorem VE.Risk.exists_minimal

theorem VE.Risk.lessWorst_iff
  ∀ (R : VE.Risk.RiskDoc) (B : VE.Structure) (a' a : B.Carrier),
    VE.Risk.LessWorst R B a' a ↔
      ∃ h,
        B.domain R.alt.harm h ∧
          ∃ s,
            B.domain R.sev s ∧
              B.relation VE.Risk.mightName [a, h] ∧
                B.relation VE.Risk.classPred [h, s] ∧
                  ∀ (h' : B.Carrier),
                    B.domain R.alt.harm h' →
                      B.relation VE.Risk.mightName [a', h'] →
                        ∃ s',
                          B.domain R.sev s' ∧
                            B.relation VE.Risk.classPred [h', s'] ∧ B.relation VE.Risk.moreSeverePred [s, s']
  -- uses VE.Alternatives.AltEnv.harm@VE.Alternatives.Decl VE.Risk.LessWorst@VE.Risk.Words VE.Risk.RiskDoc.alt@VE.Risk.Decl VE.Risk.RiskDoc.sev@VE.Risk.Decl VE.Risk.RiskDoc@VE.Risk.Decl VE.Risk.classPred@VE.Risk.Decl VE.Risk.mightName@VE.Risk.Decl VE.Risk.moreSeverePred@VE.Risk.Decl VE.Structure.Carrier@VE.Semantics VE.Structure.domain@VE.Semantics VE.Structure.relation@VE.Semantics VE.Structure@VE.Semantics

theorem VE.Risk.scanConflict_sound
  ∀ (R : VE.Risk.RiskDoc),
    VE.Risk.WellFormedRisk R = Bool.true →
      ∀ (d : VE.Risk.Decision) (e : VE.Risk.Endpoint),
        e ∈ VE.Risk.endpoints d →
          ∀ (dir : VE.Risk.Dir),
            (∀ (x : Int),
                VE.Risk.scanConflict R d e dir = Option.some x →
                  VE.Risk.Beyond dir (VE.Risk.current d e) x ∧
                    VE.Risk.outcomeAt R d e x = VE.Risk.Outcome.conflict ∧
                      ∀ (y : Int),
                        VE.Risk.Beyond dir (VE.Risk.current d e) y →
                          VE.Risk.Beyond dir y x → VE.Risk.outcomeAt R d e y ≠ VE.Risk.Outcome.conflict) ∧
              (VE.Risk.scanConflict R d e dir = Option.none →
                ∀ (y : Int),
                  VE.Risk.Beyond dir (VE.Risk.current d e) y → VE.Risk.outcomeAt R d e y ≠ VE.Risk.Outcome.conflict)

theorem VE.Risk.scanWith_sound
  ∀ {R : VE.Risk.RiskDoc} {d : VE.Risk.Decision} {e : VE.Risk.Endpoint} {dir : VE.Risk.Dir} {P : VE.Risk.Outcome → Bool},
    VE.Risk.current d e + 1 ∈ VE.Risk.candidates R d e →
      VE.Risk.current d e - 1 ∈ VE.Risk.candidates R d e →
        (∀ (x : Int),
            ¬x ∈ VE.Risk.candidates R d e ∨ ¬x + 1 ∈ VE.Risk.candidates R d e →
              VE.Risk.outcomeAt R d e x = VE.Risk.outcomeAt R d e (x + 1)) →
          (∀ (x : Int),
              VE.Risk.scanWith R d e dir P = Option.some x →
                VE.Risk.Beyond dir (VE.Risk.current d e) x ∧
                  P (VE.Risk.outcomeAt R d e x) = Bool.true ∧
                    ∀ (y : Int),
                      VE.Risk.Beyond dir (VE.Risk.current d e) y →
                        VE.Risk.Beyond dir y x → P (VE.Risk.outcomeAt R d e y) = Bool.false) ∧
            (VE.Risk.scanWith R d e dir P = Option.none →
              ∀ (y : Int), VE.Risk.Beyond dir (VE.Risk.current d e) y → P (VE.Risk.outcomeAt R d e y) = Bool.false)
  -- uses VE.Risk.Beyond@VE.Risk.Report VE.Risk.Decision@VE.Risk.Record VE.Risk.Dir@VE.Risk.Report VE.Risk.Endpoint@VE.Risk.Report VE.Risk.Outcome@VE.Risk.Report VE.Risk.RiskDoc@VE.Risk.Decl VE.Risk.candidates@VE.Risk.Report VE.Risk.current@VE.Risk.Report VE.Risk.outcomeAt@VE.Risk.Report VE.Risk.scanWith@VE.Risk.Report

theorem VE.Risk.scan_sound
  ∀ (R : VE.Risk.RiskDoc),
    VE.Risk.WellFormedRisk R = Bool.true →
      ∀ (d : VE.Risk.Decision) (e : VE.Risk.Endpoint),
        e ∈ VE.Risk.endpoints d →
          ∀ (dir : VE.Risk.Dir) (a : String) (ss : List (String × VE.Risk.Status)) (s : VE.Risk.Status),
            VE.Risk.outcomeAt R d e (VE.Risk.current d e) = VE.Risk.Outcome.statuses ss →
              List.lookup a ss = Option.some s →
                (∀ (x : Int),
                    VE.Risk.scan R d e dir a = Option.some x →
                      VE.Risk.Beyond dir (VE.Risk.current d e) x ∧
                        (∃ ss',
                            VE.Risk.outcomeAt R d e x = VE.Risk.Outcome.statuses ss' ∧
                              List.lookup a ss' ≠ Option.some s) ∧
                          ∀ (y : Int),
                            VE.Risk.Beyond dir (VE.Risk.current d e) y →
                              VE.Risk.Beyond dir y x → VE.Risk.StatusKept (VE.Risk.outcomeAt R d e y) a s) ∧
                  (VE.Risk.scan R d e dir a = Option.none →
                    ∀ (y : Int),
                      VE.Risk.Beyond dir (VE.Risk.current d e) y → VE.Risk.StatusKept (VE.Risk.outcomeAt R d e y) a s)
  -- uses VE.Risk.Beyond@VE.Risk.Report VE.Risk.Decision@VE.Risk.Record VE.Risk.Dir@VE.Risk.Report VE.Risk.Endpoint@VE.Risk.Report VE.Risk.Outcome.statuses@VE.Risk.Report VE.Risk.Outcome@VE.Risk.Report VE.Risk.RiskDoc@VE.Risk.Decl VE.Risk.Status@VE.Risk.Record VE.Risk.StatusKept@VE.Risk.Report VE.Risk.WellFormedRisk@VE.Risk.Decl VE.Risk.current@VE.Risk.Report VE.Risk.endpoints@VE.Risk.Report VE.Risk.outcomeAt@VE.Risk.Report VE.Risk.scan@VE.Risk.Report

theorem VE.Risk.sign_regions
  ∀ (c K y : Int),
    c ≠ 0 →
      have fl := (VE.Risk.floorCeil K c).fst;
      (y ≤ fl - 1 → (0 < c → c * y + K < 0) ∧ (c < 0 → 0 < c * y + K)) ∧
        (fl + 1 ≤ y → (0 < c → 0 < c * y + K) ∧ (c < 0 → c * y + K < 0))
  -- uses VE.Risk.floorCeil@VE.Risk.Report
  -- expr 3663993070
theorem VE.Risk.sign_step
  ∀ (c K x : Int),
    c ≠ 0 →
      ¬x ∈
              [(VE.Risk.floorCeil K c).fst - 1, (VE.Risk.floorCeil K c).fst, (VE.Risk.floorCeil K c).snd,
                (VE.Risk.floorCeil K c).snd + 1] ∨
          ¬x + 1 ∈
              [(VE.Risk.floorCeil K c).fst - 1, (VE.Risk.floorCeil K c).fst, (VE.Risk.floorCeil K c).snd,
                (VE.Risk.floorCeil K c).snd + 1] →
        VE.Risk.SignEq (c * x + K) (c * (x + 1) + K)
  -- uses VE.Risk.SignEq@VE.Risk.Piecewise VE.Risk.floorCeil@VE.Risk.Report

theorem VE.Risk.stepEq_eval
  ∀ (b : VE.Risk.Box),
    b.WF →
      ∀ (f : VE.Risk.LinForm),
        f.Normal →
          ∀ (l : List (String × Int)) (v : VE.Risk.Valuation) (need : Int),
            (List.map (fun x => x.fst) l).Nodup →
              (∀ (p : String × Int), p ∈ l → p ∈ f.coeffs) →
                (∀ (p : String × Int), p ∈ l → v p.fst = if 0 ≤ p.snd then b.lo p.fst else b.hi p.fst) →
                  0 ≤ need →
                    f.eval (VE.Risk.stepEq b l v need) = f.eval v + Min.min need (VE.Risk.capacity b l) ∧
                      (∀ (q : String), ¬q ∈ List.map (fun x => x.fst) l → VE.Risk.stepEq b l v need q = v q) ∧
                        ∀ (p : String × Int),
                          p ∈ l →
                            b.lo p.fst ≤ VE.Risk.stepEq b l v need p.fst ∧ VE.Risk.stepEq b l v need p.fst ≤ b.hi p.fst

theorem VE.Risk.walk
  ∀ {α : Type} {O : Int → α} {C : List Int} (dir : VE.Risk.Dir) (cur : Int),
    cur + 1 ∈ C →
      cur - 1 ∈ C →
        ∀ (hpw : ∀ (x : Int), ¬x ∈ C ∨ ¬x + 1 ∈ C → O x = O (x + 1)) (y : Int) (hy : VE.Risk.Beyond dir cur y),
          ∃ z,
            z ∈ C ∧
              VE.Risk.Beyond dir cur z ∧
                (match dir, hpw, hy with
                  | VE.Risk.Dir.up, hpw, hy => z ≤ y
                  | VE.Risk.Dir.down, hpw, hy => y ≤ z) ∧
                  O z = O y
  -- uses VE.Risk.Beyond@VE.Risk.Report VE.Risk.Dir.down@VE.Risk.Report VE.Risk.Dir.up@VE.Risk.Report VE.Risk.Dir@VE.Risk.Report VE.Risk.walk.match_1@VE.Risk.Report
  -- expr 2452029081
theorem VE.Risk.walk_down
  ∀ {α : Type} {O : Int → α} {C : List Int} (cur : Int),
    cur - 1 ∈ C →
      (∀ (x : Int), ¬x ∈ C ∨ ¬x + 1 ∈ C → O x = O (x + 1)) →
        ∀ (n : Nat) (y : Int), y = cur - 1 - ↑n → ∃ z, z ∈ C ∧ z < cur ∧ y ≤ z ∧ O z = O y

  -- expr 3307305628

  ∀ (d : VE.Order.ModelData VE.Order.Wire.Entity) (ps : List String) (fs : List VE.Order.Formula) (vs : List Bool),

          (VE.Route.Budget.orderMem (VE.Route.Budget.sortOrderData d).toModel

theorem VE.Route.WireSound.forIn_yield_ok
  ∀ {α : Type} (f : α → PUnit → Except String (ForInStep PUnit)),
    (∀ (x : α) (r : PUnit) (s : ForInStep PUnit), f x r = Except.ok s → s = ForInStep.yield PUnit.unit) →
      ∀ (l : List α) (u : PUnit),
        ForIn.forIn l PUnit.unit f = Except.ok u →
          ∀ (x : α), x ∈ l → f x PUnit.unit = Except.ok (ForInStep.yield PUnit.unit)

theorem VE.Route.route_acceptance
  ∀ {L : VE.Route.Semantics} {Doc : Type} (R : VE.Route.Layer L Doc) (background : List L.Formula),
    VE.Route.BackgroundSound R background →
      ∀ (checker : VE.Route.Checker L R.E_out) (d : Doc) (Γ : List L.Formula) (φ : L.Formula) (c : checker.Cert)
        (ps : List checker.Stmt) (r : checker.Stmt),
        checker.valid c ps r →
          List.map checker.formula ps = VE.Route.checkedPremises R background d Γ →
            checker.formula r = φ →
              L.Entails R.E_out (VE.Route.checkedPremises R background d Γ) φ ∧
                (∀ (S : L.Model), R.Admissible_out S → R.Intended d S → L.Sat S Γ → L.Holds S φ) ∧
                  ((∀ (a : L.Formula), a ∈ Γ → L.WellFormed R.E_in a) →
                    L.WellFormed R.E_in φ → ∀ (S₀ : L.Model), R.Admissible_in S₀ → L.Sat S₀ Γ → L.Holds S₀ φ)

theorem VE.Senses.candidatesOf_complete
  ∀ {D : VE.Senses.Dictionary} {A : VE.Senses.Assignment} {E : VE.EnglishGrammar.Env} {L : VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon}
    {used : List String} {b sentence : Nat} {st : VE.EnglishGrammar.DState} {w : Array VE.EnglishGrammar.Tok}
    (cs : List (List (String × Nat))) (j : Nat)
    (xs : List (VE.Senses.Candidate × VE.EnglishGrammar.DState × List VE.Senses.SenseOccurrence)),
    VE.Senses.candidatesOf D A E L used b sentence st w cs j = Except.ok xs →
      ∀ (c : List (String × Nat)),
        c ∈ cs →
          ∀ (P2 : VE.Senses.Projection),
            VE.Senses.project D (A.extend c) E L used = Except.ok P2 →
              ∀ (F : VE.EnglishGrammar.EFormula) (m : Bool),
                (VE.Grammar.readSentence (VE.EnglishGrammar.grammar P2.env P2.lexicon)
                        (VE.EnglishGrammar.meaning (VE.EnglishGrammar.grammar P2.env P2.lexicon)
                          (VE.EnglishGrammar.acts P2.env P2.lexicon))
                        st b w).fst =
                    VE.Grammar.Outcome.ok F m →
                  VE.EnglishGrammar.typedDocument P2.env [F] = Bool.true →
                    ∃ x, x ∈ xs ∧ x.fst.choice = c ∧ x.fst.formula = F ∧ x.fst.mark = m
  -- uses VE.EnglishGrammar.DState@VE.EnglishGrammar.Syntax VE.EnglishGrammar.EFormula@VE.EnglishGrammar.Syntax VE.EnglishGrammar.Env@VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon@VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon VE.EnglishGrammar.Reject@VE.EnglishGrammar.Syntax VE.EnglishGrammar.Terminal@VE.EnglishGrammar.Token VE.EnglishGrammar.Tok@VE.EnglishGrammar.Token VE.EnglishGrammar.acts@VE.EnglishGrammar.Actions VE.EnglishGrammar.grammar@VE.EnglishGrammar.Rules VE.EnglishGrammar.instAcceptsTerminalTok@VE.EnglishGrammar.Token VE.EnglishGrammar.instDecidableEqTerminal@VE.EnglishGrammar.Token VE.EnglishGrammar.instDecidableEqTok@VE.EnglishGrammar.Token VE.EnglishGrammar.meaning@VE.EnglishGrammar.Read VE.EnglishGrammar.typedDocument@VE.EnglishGrammar.Encode VE.Grammar.Outcome.ok@VE.Grammar.Reading VE.Grammar.Outcome@VE.Grammar.Reading VE.Grammar.readSentence@VE.Grammar.Reading VE.Senses.Assignment.extend@VE.Senses.Assignment VE.Senses.Assignment@VE.Senses.Assignment VE.Senses.Candidate.choice@VE.Senses.Read VE.Senses.Candidate.formula@VE.Senses.Read VE.Senses.Candidate.mark@VE.Senses.Read VE.Senses.Candidate@VE.Senses.Read VE.Senses.Dictionary@VE.Senses.Dictionary VE.Senses.Projection.env@VE.Senses.Project VE.Senses.Projection.lexicon@VE.Senses.Project VE.Senses.Projection@VE.Senses.Project VE.Senses.SenseFault@VE.Senses.Preamble VE.Senses.SenseOccurrence@VE.Senses.Read VE.Senses.Stop@VE.Senses.Read VE.Senses.candidatesOf@VE.Senses.Read VE.Senses.project@VE.Senses.Project

theorem VE.Senses.candidates_complete
  ∀ (D : VE.Senses.Dictionary) (E : VE.EnglishGrammar.Env) (L : VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon) (b : Nat) (s : String)
    (units : List VE.Senses.SenseUnit) (sm : List VE.Senses.SenseOccurrence) (mx : List (String × List String))
    (un : List String) (P : VE.Senses.Projection) (i : Nat) (u : VE.Senses.SenseUnit) (choice : List (String × Nat))
    (F : VE.EnglishGrammar.EFormula) (m : Bool),
    VE.Senses.readWithSenses D E L b s = VE.Senses.SensesOutcome.ok units sm mx un P →
      units[i]? = Option.some u →
        u.candidates ≠ [] →
          ((choice ∈ VE.Senses.choicesOf D u.unresolved ∧
              ∃ sents A k P2 w,
                VE.EnglishGrammar.lex s = Except.ok sents ∧
                  VE.Senses.readPreamble D b (List.map (fun x => x.toList) sents.toList) = Except.ok (A, k) ∧
                    VE.Senses.project D (A.extend choice) E L
                          (VE.Senses.usedWords D (List.map (fun x => x.toList) (List.drop k sents.toList))) =
                        Except.ok P2 ∧
                      (List.drop k sents.toList)[i]? = Option.some w ∧
                        (VE.Grammar.readSentence (VE.EnglishGrammar.grammar P2.env P2.lexicon)
                                (VE.EnglishGrammar.meaning (VE.EnglishGrammar.grammar P2.env P2.lexicon)
                                  (VE.EnglishGrammar.acts P2.env P2.lexicon))
                                (VE.Senses.stateBefore units i) b w).fst =
                            VE.Grammar.Outcome.ok F m ∧
                          VE.EnglishGrammar.typedDocument P2.env [F] = Bool.true) ↔

theorem VE.Senses.document_unit_sound
  ∀ (D : VE.Senses.Dictionary) (E : VE.EnglishGrammar.Env) (L : VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon) (b : Nat)
    (A : VE.Senses.Assignment) (fs : List String) (units : List VE.Senses.SenseUnit) (sm : List VE.Senses.SenseOccurrence)
    (mx : List (String × List String)) (un : List String) (P : VE.Senses.Projection) (j i : Nat),
    VE.Senses.readDocument D E L b A (VE.Senses.SenseText.fences fs) =
        Except.ok (VE.Senses.SensesOutcome.ok units sm mx un P) →
      (∃ d sents,
          VE.Senses.documentInput D A (VE.Senses.SenseText.fences fs) = Except.ok (Except.ok (d, sents)) ∧

        ∃ f w u,
          fs[j]? = Option.some f ∧
            VE.EnglishGrammar.lex f = Except.ok #[w] ∧
              units[i]? = Option.some u ∧
                (u.formula.isSome = Bool.true ∨ u.candidates ≠ []) ∧
                  ∀ (F : VE.EnglishGrammar.EFormula) (m : Bool),
                    u.formula = Option.some (F, m) →
                      u.candidates = [] ∧
                        (VE.EnglishGrammar.grammar P.env P.lexicon).wf = Bool.true ∧
                          VE.Grammar.readSentence (VE.EnglishGrammar.grammar P.env P.lexicon)
                              (VE.EnglishGrammar.meaning (VE.EnglishGrammar.grammar P.env P.lexicon)
                                (VE.EnglishGrammar.acts P.env P.lexicon))
                              (VE.Senses.stateBefore units i) b w =
                            (VE.Grammar.Outcome.ok F m, u.after)

theorem VE.Senses.readSents_ok
  ∀ {D : VE.Senses.Dictionary} {E : VE.EnglishGrammar.Env} {L : VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon} {b : Nat}
    {sents : List (Array VE.EnglishGrammar.Tok)} {units : List VE.Senses.SenseUnit} {sm : List VE.Senses.SenseOccurrence}
    {mx : List (String × List String)} {un : List String} {P : VE.Senses.Projection},
    VE.Senses.readSents D E L b sents = VE.Senses.SensesOutcome.ok units sm mx un P →
      ∃ A k,
        VE.Senses.readPreamble D b (List.map (fun x => x.toList) sents) = Except.ok (A, k) ∧
          List.drop k sents ≠ [] ∧
            VE.Senses.project D A E L (VE.Senses.usedWords D (List.map (fun x => x.toList) (List.drop k sents))) =
                Except.ok P ∧
              VE.Senses.grammarFault P = Option.none ∧
                VE.Senses.readBody D A E L (VE.Senses.usedWords D (List.map (fun x => x.toList) (List.drop k sents))) P b
                      k 0 VE.EnglishGrammar.DState.init (List.drop k sents) =
                    Except.ok (units, sm) ∧
                  mx = VE.Senses.mixedOf P units ∧
                    ((List.filterMap (fun x => x.formula) units).isEmpty ||
                        VE.EnglishGrammar.typedDocument P.env
                          (List.map (fun x => x.fst) (List.filterMap (fun x => x.formula) units))) =
                      Bool.true

theorem VE.Senses.readWithSenses_ok
  ∀ {D : VE.Senses.Dictionary} {E : VE.EnglishGrammar.Env} {L : VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon} {b : Nat} {s : String}
    {units : List VE.Senses.SenseUnit} {sm : List VE.Senses.SenseOccurrence} {mx : List (String × List String)}
    {un : List String} {P : VE.Senses.Projection},
    VE.Senses.readWithSenses D E L b s = VE.Senses.SensesOutcome.ok units sm mx un P →
      ∃ sents A k,
        VE.EnglishGrammar.lex s = Except.ok sents ∧
          VE.Senses.readPreamble D b (List.map (fun x => x.toList) sents.toList) = Except.ok (A, k) ∧
            List.drop k sents.toList ≠ [] ∧
              VE.Senses.project D A E L
                    (VE.Senses.usedWords D (List.map (fun x => x.toList) (List.drop k sents.toList))) =
                  Except.ok P ∧
                VE.Senses.grammarFault P = Option.none ∧
                  VE.Senses.readBody D A E L
                        (VE.Senses.usedWords D (List.map (fun x => x.toList) (List.drop k sents.toList))) P b k 0
                        VE.EnglishGrammar.DState.init (List.drop k sents.toList) =
                      Except.ok (units, sm) ∧
                    mx = VE.Senses.mixedOf P units ∧
                      ((List.filterMap (fun x => x.formula) units).isEmpty ||
                          VE.EnglishGrammar.typedDocument P.env

theorem VE.Senses.senses_candidate_sound
  ∀ (D : VE.Senses.Dictionary) (E : VE.EnglishGrammar.Env) (L : VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon) (b : Nat) (s : String)
    (units : List VE.Senses.SenseUnit) (sm : List VE.Senses.SenseOccurrence) (mx : List (String × List String))
    (un : List String) (P : VE.Senses.Projection) (i : Nat) (u : VE.Senses.SenseUnit) (c : VE.Senses.Candidate),
    VE.Senses.readWithSenses D E L b s = VE.Senses.SensesOutcome.ok units sm mx un P →
      units[i]? = Option.some u →
        c ∈ u.candidates →
          u.formula = Option.none ∧
            ∃ sents A k P2 w,
              VE.EnglishGrammar.lex s = Except.ok sents ∧
                VE.Senses.readPreamble D b (List.map (fun x => x.toList) sents.toList) = Except.ok (A, k) ∧
                  VE.Senses.project D (A.extend c.choice) E L
                        (VE.Senses.usedWords D (List.map (fun x => x.toList) (List.drop k sents.toList))) =
                      Except.ok P2 ∧
                    VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon.valid P2.env { } P2.lexicon = Bool.true ∧
                      (VE.EnglishGrammar.grammar P2.env P2.lexicon).wf = Bool.true ∧
                        c.lines = VE.Senses.Assignment.lines D (A.extend c.choice) ∧
                          (List.drop k sents.toList)[i]? = Option.some w ∧
                            VE.Grammar.readSentence (VE.EnglishGrammar.grammar P2.env P2.lexicon)
                                  (VE.EnglishGrammar.meaning (VE.EnglishGrammar.grammar P2.env P2.lexicon)
                                    (VE.EnglishGrammar.acts P2.env P2.lexicon))
                                  (VE.Senses.stateBefore units i) b w =
                                (VE.Grammar.Outcome.ok c.formula c.mark, u.after) ∧
                              VE.EnglishGrammar.typedDocument P2.env [c.formula] = Bool.true

theorem VE.Senses.senses_unit_sound
  ∀ (D : VE.Senses.Dictionary) (E : VE.EnglishGrammar.Env) (L : VE.EnglishGrammar.Lexicon) (b : Nat) (s : String)
    (units : List VE.Senses.SenseUnit) (sm : List VE.Senses.SenseOccurrence) (mx : List (String × List String))
    (un : List String) (P : VE.Senses.Projection) (i : Nat) (u : VE.Senses.SenseUnit),
    VE.Senses.readWithSenses D E L b s = VE.Senses.SensesOutcome.ok units sm mx un P →
      units[i]? = Option.some u →
        (u.formula.isSome = Bool.true ∨ u.candidates ≠ []) ∧
          ∀ (F : VE.EnglishGrammar.EFormula) (m : Bool),
            u.formula = Option.some (F, m) →
              u.candidates = [] ∧
                ∃ sents A k w,
                  VE.EnglishGrammar.lex s = Except.ok sents ∧
                    VE.Senses.readPreamble D b (List.map (fun x => x.toList) sents.toList) = Except.ok (A, k) ∧
                      VE.Senses.project D A E L
                            (VE.Senses.usedWords D (List.map (fun x => x.toList) (List.drop k sents.toList))) =
                          Except.ok P ∧
                        (List.drop k sents.toList)[i]? = Option.some w ∧
                          (VE.EnglishGrammar.grammar P.env P.lexicon).wf = Bool.true ∧
                            VE.Grammar.readSentence (VE.EnglishGrammar.grammar P.env P.lexicon)
                                (VE.EnglishGrammar.meaning (VE.EnglishGrammar.grammar P.env P.lexicon)
                                  (VE.EnglishGrammar.acts P.env P.lexicon))
                                (VE.Senses.stateBefore units i) b w =
                              (VE.Grammar.Outcome.ok F m, u.after)

theorem VE.Service.FamilyBundle.bundle_sound
  ∀ {F C : Type} [inst : DecidableEq F] {Model : Type v} (Adm : Model → Prop) (Holds : Model → F → Prop)
    (valid : C → List F → F → Bool) (steps : C → Nat) (disj : F → F → F),
    (∀ (c : C) (ps : List F) (r : F), valid c ps r = Bool.true → VE.Service.GenericGraph.Ent Adm Holds ps r) →
      ∀ (bg : List (VE.Service.FamilyBundle.Leaf F)) (sets : List (VE.Service.FamilyBundle.ReadingSet F))
        (bind : List Lean.Json → Lean.Json → C → Except String Unit) (Ls : List (VE.Service.FamilyBundle.Lemma F C))
        (res : List (VE.Service.FamilyBundle.Known F)),
        VE.Service.FamilyBundle.checkAll valid steps disj bg sets bind [] Ls = Except.ok res →
          ∀ (k : VE.Service.FamilyBundle.Known F),
            k ∈ res →
              (VE.Service.FamilyBundle.ReadingCompatible k.leaves ∧
                  VE.Service.FamilyBundle.ReadingBound disj sets k.leaves) ∧
                ∀ (S : Model),
                  Adm S → (∀ (l : VE.Service.FamilyBundle.Leaf F), l ∈ k.leaves → Holds S l.snd) → Holds S k.conclusion
  -- uses VE.Service.FamilyBundle.Known.conclusion@VE.Service.FamilyBundle VE.Service.FamilyBundle.Known.leaves@VE.Service.FamilyBundle VE.Service.FamilyBundle.Known@VE.Service.FamilyBundle VE.Service.FamilyBundle.Leaf@VE.Service.FamilyBundle VE.Service.FamilyBundle.Lemma@VE.Service.FamilyBundle VE.Service.FamilyBundle.ReadingBound@VE.Service.FamilyBundle VE.Service.FamilyBundle.ReadingCompatible@VE.Service.FamilyBundle VE.Service.FamilyBundle.ReadingSet@VE.Service.FamilyBundle VE.Service.FamilyBundle.checkAll@VE.Service.FamilyBundle VE.Service.GenericGraph.Ent@VE.Service.GenericGraph

  ∀ {F : Type} (disj : F → F → F) (bot : F) {Model : Type v} (Adm : Model → Prop) (Holds : Model → F → Prop),
    (∀ (S : Model) (a b : F), Holds S (disj a b) ↔ Holds S a ∨ Holds S b) →

theorem VE.Service.runRequest_ok
  ∀ (h : VE.Service.Handles) (r : VE.Service.Request) (budget : VE.Service.Budget)
    (cases expanded : Array (Except String Lean.Json)) (digests : Array String),
    r.budget = Except.ok budget →
      r.cases.utf8ByteSize ≤ budget.bytes →
        r.cases.trim.startsWith "[" = Bool.true →
          VE.Service.decodeCases r = Except.ok cases →
            cases.size ≤ budget.cases →
              VE.Service.caseDigests r.cases = Except.ok digests →
                digests.size = cases.size →
                  VE.Service.expandCases h r.mode cases = Except.ok expanded →
                    VE.Service.runRequest h r = Except.ok (VE.Service.response r expanded digests)
  -- uses VE.Service.Budget.bytes@VE.Service.Protocol VE.Service.Budget.cases@VE.Service.Protocol VE.Service.Budget@VE.Service.Protocol VE.Service.Handles@VE.Service.Protocol VE.Service.Request.budget@VE.Service.Protocol VE.Service.Request.cases@VE.Service.Protocol VE.Service.Request.mode@VE.Service.Protocol VE.Service.Request@VE.Service.Protocol VE.Service.caseDigests@VE.Service.Protocol VE.Service.decodeCases@VE.Service.Protocol VE.Service.expandCases@VE.Service.Protocol VE.Service.response@VE.Service.Protocol VE.Service.runRequest@VE.Service.Protocol
  -- expr 1959429401
theorem VE.SoftNorms.Admission.admitDocument_spec
  ∀ (environment document : Lean.Json) (res : VE.SoftNorms.Admission.Admitted),
    VE.SoftNorms.Admission.admitDocument environment document = Except.ok res →
      VE.SoftNorms.Admission.SourceDecoded environment document res ∧
        VE.SoftNorms.Admission.CertificatesBound environment res ∧
          VE.Graph.SoundReport (VE.SoftNorms.envPrime res.src.D) res.graph res.report ∧
            (∀ (w : VE.Route.Admission.WireNode), w ∈ res.wires → VE.SoftNorms.Admission.NodeAdmitted res.src res.doc w) ∧
              (∀ (leaf : VE.Graph.Claim),
                  leaf ∈ res.report.assumptions →
                    ∃ w,
                      w ∈ res.wires ∧
                        w.claim = leaf ∧
                          w.deduction = Option.none ∧ VE.SoftNorms.Admission.NodeAdmitted res.src res.doc w) ∧
                VE.Route.Admission.CitationsClosed res.doc res.report ∧ VE.Route.Admission.ChoicesCompatible res.report
  -- uses VE.Graph.Claim@VE.ClaimGraph VE.Graph.Edge@VE.ClaimGraph VE.Graph.Report.assumptions@VE.ClaimGraph VE.Graph.SoundReport@VE.ClaimGraph VE.Route.Admission.ChoicesCompatible@VE.Route.Admission VE.Route.Admission.CitationsClosed@VE.Route.Admission VE.Route.Admission.WireNode.claim@VE.Route.Admission VE.Route.Admission.WireNode.deduction@VE.Route.Admission VE.Route.Admission.WireNode@VE.Route.Admission VE.SoftNorms.Admission.Admitted.doc@VE.SoftNorms.Admission VE.SoftNorms.Admission.Admitted.graph@VE.SoftNorms.Admission VE.SoftNorms.Admission.Admitted.report@VE.SoftNorms.Admission VE.SoftNorms.Admission.Admitted.src@VE.SoftNorms.Admission VE.SoftNorms.Admission.Admitted.wires@VE.SoftNorms.Admission VE.SoftNorms.Admission.Admitted@VE.SoftNorms.Admission VE.SoftNorms.Admission.CertificatesBound@VE.SoftNorms.Admission VE.SoftNorms.Admission.NodeAdmitted@VE.SoftNorms.Admission VE.SoftNorms.Admission.SourceDecoded@VE.SoftNorms.Admission VE.SoftNorms.Admission.admitDocument@VE.SoftNorms.Admission VE.SoftNorms.Wire.SoftSource.D@VE.SoftNorms.Wire VE.SoftNorms.envPrime@VE.SoftNorms.Tree VE.Tableau.Certificate@VE.Tableau

theorem VE.SoftNorms.Wire.envAt_soften_zero
  ∀ (D : VE.SoftNorms.SoftDoc) (p : String),
    (VE.Norms.envAt (VE.SoftNorms.soften D) 0).predicates p =
      if p ∈ VE.Norms.layerNames (VE.SoftNorms.soften D).T then Option.none
      else
        match List.find? (fun x => x.fst == p) (VE.SoftNorms.decisions D) with
        | Option.some d => Option.some d.snd

theorem VE.SoftNorms.Wire.soft_wire_acceptance
  ∀ (j : Lean.Json) (r : VE.SoftNorms.Wire.SoftEntailmentReplay),
    VE.SoftNorms.Wire.replaySoftEntailment j = Except.ok r →
      r.valid = Bool.true →
        VE.SoftNorms.Wire.decodeSoftSource (j.getObjValD "environment") (j.getObjValD "norms") = Except.ok r.src ∧
          (∀ (S : VE.Structure),
              S.Admissible (VE.Norms.envAt (VE.SoftNorms.soften r.src.D) (VE.Norms.size (VE.SoftNorms.soften r.src.D))) →
                VE.SoftNorms.holdsSoft r.src.D S →
                  VE.Norms.definitionsHold (VE.SoftNorms.soften r.src.D) S →
                    VE.Norms.profileHold (VE.SoftNorms.soften r.src.D) S →
                      VE.Norms.Sat S (VE.Norms.backgroundBase (VE.SoftNorms.soften r.src.D)) →
                        VE.Norms.Sat S (VE.SoftNorms.softPremises r.src.D) →
                          VE.Norms.Sat S r.premises → VE.Formula.denote S [] r.conclusion) ∧
            (VE.SoftNorms.SoftConflictFree r.src.D →
              (∀ (a : VE.Formula),
                  a ∈ r.premises → VE.Formula.WellFormed (VE.Norms.envAt (VE.SoftNorms.soften r.src.D) 0) [] a) →
                VE.Formula.WellFormed (VE.Norms.envAt (VE.SoftNorms.soften r.src.D) 0) [] r.conclusion →
                  ∀ (B : VE.Structure),
                    VE.SoftNorms.BaseAdmissible' r.src.D B →
                      VE.Norms.Sat B r.premises → VE.Formula.denote B [] r.conclusion)
  -- uses VE.Formula.WellFormed@VE.Syntax VE.Formula.denote@VE.Semantics VE.Formula@VE.Syntax VE.Norms.Sat@VE.Norms.Prefix VE.Norms.backgroundBase@VE.Norms.Prefix VE.Norms.definitionsHold@VE.Norms.Layer VE.Norms.envAt@VE.Norms.Tree VE.Norms.profileHold@VE.Norms.Layer VE.Norms.size@VE.Norms.Tree VE.SoftNorms.BaseAdmissible'@VE.SoftNorms.Coherence VE.SoftNorms.SoftConflictFree@VE.SoftNorms.Coherence VE.SoftNorms.Wire.SoftEntailmentReplay.conclusion@VE.SoftNorms.Wire VE.SoftNorms.Wire.SoftEntailmentReplay.premises@VE.SoftNorms.Wire VE.SoftNorms.Wire.SoftEntailmentReplay.src@VE.SoftNorms.Wire VE.SoftNorms.Wire.SoftEntailmentReplay.valid@VE.SoftNorms.Wire VE.SoftNorms.Wire.SoftEntailmentReplay@VE.SoftNorms.Wire VE.SoftNorms.Wire.SoftSource.D@VE.SoftNorms.Wire VE.SoftNorms.Wire.SoftSource@VE.SoftNorms.Wire VE.SoftNorms.Wire.decodeSoftSource@VE.SoftNorms.Wire VE.SoftNorms.Wire.replaySoftEntailment@VE.SoftNorms.Wire VE.SoftNorms.holdsSoft@VE.SoftNorms.Semantics VE.SoftNorms.softPremises@VE.SoftNorms.Soften VE.SoftNorms.soften@VE.SoftNorms.Soften VE.Structure.Admissible@VE.Semantics VE.Structure.Carrier@VE.Semantics VE.Structure@VE.Semantics

theorem VE.SoftNorms.cone_independent
  ∀ (D : VE.SoftNorms.SoftDoc),
    VE.SoftNorms.WellFormedSoft D = Bool.true →
      ∀ (p : String),
        p ∈ VE.Norms.regulatedNames D.base.T →
          ∀ (Q : List String),
            (∀ (q : String), q ∈ VE.SoftNorms.cone D p → ¬q ∈ Q) →
              ∀ (B : VE.Structure) (R : String → List B.Carrier → Prop),
                (∀ (q : String) (vs : List B.Carrier), ¬q ∈ Q → (R q vs ↔ B.relation q vs)) →
                  ∀ (vs : List B.Carrier),
                    VE.Formula.denote { Carrier := B.Carrier, domain := B.domain, constant := B.constant, relation := R }

theorem VE.SoftNorms.outcome_canon
  ∀ {D : VE.SoftNorms.SoftDoc},
    VE.SoftNorms.SoftValid D →
      ∀ (B : VE.Structure),
        VE.Norms.BaseAdmissible (VE.SoftNorms.soften D) B →
          ∀ {r : VE.Norms.Regulated},
            r ∈ D.T.regulated →
              ∀ (vs : List B.Carrier),
                VE.TupleTyped B r.sorts vs →
                  (VE.Formula.denote B (VE.Norms.tupleVal vs) (VE.Norms.outcomeBase (VE.SoftNorms.soften D) r.name) ↔
                    if r.allowByDefault = Bool.true then
                      ¬VE.SoftNorms.DecidesSoftD D (VE.SoftNorms.canon (VE.SoftNorms.soften D) B) (VE.Norms.tupleVal vs)
                          r.name Bool.false
                    else
                      VE.SoftNorms.DecidesSoftD D (VE.SoftNorms.canon (VE.SoftNorms.soften D) B) (VE.Norms.tupleVal vs)
                        r.name Bool.true)
  -- uses VE.Formula.denote@VE.Semantics VE.Norms.BaseAdmissible@VE.Norms.Prefix VE.Norms.Regulated.allowByDefault@VE.Norms.Tree VE.Norms.Regulated.name@VE.Norms.Tree VE.Norms.Regulated.sorts@VE.Norms.Tree VE.Norms.Regulated@VE.Norms.Tree VE.Norms.outcomeBase@VE.Norms.Conflict VE.Norms.tupleVal@VE.Norms.Basic VE.SoftNorms.DecidesSoftD@VE.SoftNorms.Semantics VE.SoftNorms.SoftDoc.T@VE.SoftNorms.Tree VE.SoftNorms.SoftDoc@VE.SoftNorms.Tree VE.SoftNorms.SoftTree.regulated@VE.SoftNorms.Tree VE.SoftNorms.SoftValid@VE.SoftNorms.Soften VE.SoftNorms.canon@VE.SoftNorms.Coherence VE.SoftNorms.soften@VE.SoftNorms.Soften VE.Structure.Carrier@VE.Semantics VE.Structure@VE.Semantics VE.TupleTyped@VE.Semantics

theorem VE.SoftNorms.qfree_embed
  ∀ {D : VE.SoftNorms.SoftDoc} {B₀ B : VE.Structure} (e : B₀.Carrier → B.Carrier),
    (∀ (x y : B₀.Carrier), e x = e y → x = y) →
      (∀ (c : String), B.constant c = Option.map e (B₀.constant c)) →
        (∀ (p : String) (vs : List B₀.Carrier),
            ((VE.Norms.envAt (VE.SoftNorms.soften D) 0).predicates p).isSome = Bool.true →
              (B₀.relation p vs ↔ B.relation p (List.map e vs))) →
          ∀ (φ : VE.Formula) (Γ : List String) (ρ : VE.Valuation B₀),
            VE.Norms.Formula.qfree φ = Bool.true →

theorem VE.SoftNorms.weighing_point_sound
  ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : DecidableEq α] (D : VE.SoftNorms.SoftDoc),
    VE.SoftNorms.WellFormedSoft D = Bool.true →
      ∀ (M N : VE.SoftNorms.SoftNode),
        (M, N) ∈ VE.SoftNorms.collidingPairs D →
          ∀ (Mo : VE.FiniteModel α),
            Mo.Valid (VE.Norms.envAt (VE.SoftNorms.soften D) 0) →
              VE.SoftNorms.classificationBackgroundValid D Mo = Bool.true →
                ∀ (vs : List α),
                  VE.TupleTyped Mo.asStructure (VE.SoftNorms.actSorts D M) vs →
                    VE.Formula.eval Mo (VE.Norms.tupleVal vs)
                          ((VE.SoftNorms.circ D (VE.SoftNorms.selects' D M)).and
                            (VE.SoftNorms.circ D (VE.SoftNorms.selects' D N))) =
                        Bool.true →
                      ¬VE.Formula.denote Mo.asStructure [] (VE.SoftNorms.cohPremise D M N) ∧
                        ¬∀ (B : VE.Structure),
                            VE.Norms.BaseAdmissible (VE.SoftNorms.soften D) B →
                              VE.Norms.ConflictFree (VE.SoftNorms.soften D) B
  -- uses VE.FiniteModel.Valid@VE.Finite VE.FiniteModel.asStructure@VE.Finite VE.FiniteModel@VE.Finite VE.Formula.and@VE.Syntax VE.Formula.denote@VE.Semantics VE.Formula.eval@VE.Finite VE.Norms.BaseAdmissible@VE.Norms.Prefix VE.Norms.ConflictFree@VE.Norms.Conflict VE.Norms.envAt@VE.Norms.Tree VE.Norms.tupleVal@VE.Norms.Basic VE.SoftNorms.SoftDoc@VE.SoftNorms.Tree VE.SoftNorms.SoftNode@VE.SoftNorms.Tree VE.SoftNorms.WellFormedSoft@VE.SoftNorms.Soften VE.SoftNorms.actSorts@VE.SoftNorms.Tree VE.SoftNorms.circ@VE.SoftNorms.Semantics VE.SoftNorms.classificationBackgroundValid@VE.SoftNorms.Coherence VE.SoftNorms.cohPremise@VE.SoftNorms.Soften VE.SoftNorms.collidingPairs@VE.SoftNorms.Tree VE.SoftNorms.selects'@VE.SoftNorms.Soften VE.SoftNorms.soften@VE.SoftNorms.Soften VE.Structure.Carrier@VE.Semantics VE.Structure@VE.Semantics VE.TupleTyped@VE.Semantics

theorem VE.SoftNorms.weighing_points_complete
  ∀ (D : VE.SoftNorms.SoftDoc),
    VE.SoftNorms.WellFormedSoft D = Bool.true →
      ∀ (S : VE.Structure) (ρ : VE.Valuation S),
        (∀ (p : String),
            VE.SoftNorms.DefaultDecidesD D S ρ p Bool.true →
              VE.SoftNorms.DefaultDecidesD D S ρ p Bool.false →
                ∃ M N,
                  (M, N) ∈ VE.SoftNorms.collidingPairs D ∧
                    M.pred = p ∧
                      N.pred = p ∧
                        VE.SoftNorms.SelectsSoftD D S ρ (VE.SoftNorms.fuel D) M ∧
                          VE.SoftNorms.SelectsSoftD D S ρ (VE.SoftNorms.fuel D) N ∧
                            VE.SoftNorms.Comparable D M N = Bool.false) ∧
          ∀ (pr : VE.Norms.Pair),
            pr ∈ VE.Norms.pairs (VE.SoftNorms.soften D).T →
              VE.SoftNorms.DefaultDecidesD D S ρ pr.req Bool.true →
                VE.SoftNorms.DefaultDecidesD D S ρ pr.perm Bool.false →
                  ∃ M N,
                    (M, N) ∈ VE.SoftNorms.collidingPairs D ∧
                      (M.pred = pr.req ∧ N.pred = pr.perm ∨ M.pred = pr.perm ∧ N.pred = pr.req) ∧
                        VE.SoftNorms.SelectsSoftD D S ρ (VE.SoftNorms.fuel D) M ∧
                          VE.SoftNorms.SelectsSoftD D S ρ (VE.SoftNorms.fuel D) N ∧
                            VE.SoftNorms.Comparable D M N = Bool.false
  -- uses VE.Norms.Doc.T@VE.Norms.Tree VE.Norms.Node.pred@VE.Norms.Tree VE.Norms.Pair.perm@VE.Norms.Tree VE.Norms.Pair.req@VE.Norms.Tree VE.Norms.Pair@VE.Norms.Tree VE.Norms.pairs@VE.Norms.Tree VE.SoftNorms.Comparable@VE.SoftNorms.Tree VE.SoftNorms.DefaultDecidesD@VE.SoftNorms.Semantics VE.SoftNorms.SelectsSoftD@VE.SoftNorms.Semantics VE.SoftNorms.SoftDoc@VE.SoftNorms.Tree VE.SoftNorms.SoftNode.toNode@VE.SoftNorms.Tree VE.SoftNorms.SoftNode@VE.SoftNorms.Tree VE.SoftNorms.WellFormedSoft@VE.SoftNorms.Soften VE.SoftNorms.collidingPairs@VE.SoftNorms.Tree VE.SoftNorms.fuel@VE.SoftNorms.Tree VE.SoftNorms.soften@VE.SoftNorms.Soften VE.Structure@VE.Semantics VE.Valuation@VE.Semantics

      VE.SpeechActs.WellFormedSpeech r.dec.D = Bool.true ∧
        r.q ∈ r.dec.D.questions ∧
          (∀ (a : VE.SpeechActs.Answer) (φ : VE.Formula) (hφ : VE.SpeechActs.correct r.dec.D r.q a = Option.some φ)

                      VE.Norms.Sat S (VE.SpeechActs.premises r.dec.D) → VE.SpeechActs.AnswersAt r.dec.D r.q S a) ∧

                    r.replay.accepted = Bool.true →
                      ∀ (S : VE.Structure),
                        S.Admissible (VE.SpeechActs.En r.dec.D) →
                          VE.Norms.Sat S (VE.SpeechActs.premises r.dec.D) →

                ∀ (id : String) (m : VE.SpeechActs.Run.CheckedModel r.dec.D (VE.SpeechActs.premises r.dec.D)),

          ∃ adm id rid,

                      a = VE.SpeechActs.Source.Admission.encodeAdmitted id rid adm ∧
                        VE.SpeechActs.Source.Admission.BindingsMatchSourceAndRegeneration adm rid ∧
                          VE.SpeechActs.Source.Admission.ReportAdmitted adm ∧
                            (∀ (S : VE.Structure),
                                S.Admissible (VE.SpeechActs.En adm.src.dec.D) →
                                  VE.Norms.Sat S (VE.Data.Background.generate adm.p0.flags) →

                                          (List.map (fun x => x.formula)
                                            (VE.SpeechActs.Source.Admission.otherAssumptions adm)) →
                                        VE.Formula.denote S [] adm.report.root.formula) ∧
                              VE.SpeechActs.Source.Admission.RecordsSound adm.src

  ∀ {D : VE.SpeechActs.SpeechDoc},
    VE.SpeechActs.WellFormedSpeech D = Bool.true →

        c ∈ D.commands →
          ∃ r s you,
            VE.SpeechActs.regOf D c.act = Option.some r ∧
              D.scope.addressee = Option.some (s, you) ∧

theorem VE.SpeechActs.demand_conflict
  ∀ (D : VE.SpeechActs.SpeechDoc),
    VE.SpeechActs.WellFormedSpeech D = Bool.true →
      ∀ (c : VE.SpeechActs.Command),
        c ∈ D.commands →
          ∀ (S : VE.Structure),
            S.Admissible (VE.SpeechActs.En D) →
              ∀ (vs : List S.Carrier),
                VE.TupleTyped S (VE.SpeechActs.actSorts D c) vs →
                  VE.Norms.AgreesBelow (VE.SpeechActs.policy D) (VE.Norms.before (VE.SpeechActs.policy D) c.act) S →
                    VE.SpeechActs.boundTuple D c S = Option.some vs →
                      VE.Formula.denote S [] c.guard →
                        VE.Norms.DecidesD (VE.SpeechActs.policy D).T S (VE.Norms.tupleVal vs) c.act
                            !Decidable.decide (c.force = VE.SpeechActs.Force.require) →
                          ¬VE.Norms.ConflictFree (VE.SpeechActs.policy D)
                              (VE.Norms.restrictAll (VE.SpeechActs.policy D).T S)

  ∀ (D : VE.SpeechActs.SpeechDoc),
    VE.SpeechActs.WellFormedSpeech D = Bool.true →
      ∀ (c : VE.SpeechActs.Command),
        c ∈ D.commands →
          ∀ (S : VE.Structure),
            S.Admissible (VE.SpeechActs.En D) →
              VE.Norms.Sat S (VE.Norms.elaborate (VE.SpeechActs.policy D).T) →

theorem VE.SpeechActs.demand_polarity
  ∀ (D : VE.SpeechActs.SpeechDoc),
    VE.SpeechActs.WellFormedSpeech D = Bool.true →
      ∀ (c : VE.SpeechActs.Command),
        c ∈ D.commands →
          (c.force = VE.SpeechActs.Force.require →
              (VE.SpeechActs.demand D c).sign = Bool.true ∧

  ∀ (D D₂ : VE.SpeechActs.SpeechDoc),
    VE.SpeechActs.WellFormedSpeech D = Bool.true →
      VE.SpeechActs.WellFormedSpeech D₂ = Bool.true →
        VE.SpeechActs.core D = VE.SpeechActs.core D₂ →
          ∀ (Γ : List VE.Formula) (φ : VE.Formula) (c : VE.Tableau.Certificate),

theorem VE.SpeechActs.speech_route_acceptance
  ∀ (D : VE.SpeechActs.SpeechDoc),
    VE.SpeechActs.WellFormedSpeech D = Bool.true →
      (∀ (B : VE.Structure),
          VE.Norms.BaseAdmissible (VE.SpeechActs.policy D) B → VE.Norms.ConflictFree (VE.SpeechActs.policy D) B) →
        ∀ (Γ : List VE.Formula) (φ : VE.Formula) (c : VE.Tableau.Certificate),
          VE.Tableau.checkCertificate (VE.SpeechActs.En D)
                (VE.Norms.background (VE.SpeechActs.policy D) ++ VE.Norms.elaborate (VE.SpeechActs.policy D).T ++ Γ) φ c =
              Bool.true →
            (∀ (S : VE.Structure),
                S.Admissible (VE.SpeechActs.En D) →
                  VE.Norms.holdsCatala (VE.SpeechActs.policy D).T S →
                    VE.Norms.definitionsHold (VE.SpeechActs.policy D) S →
                      VE.Norms.profileHold (VE.SpeechActs.policy D) S →
                        VE.Norms.Sat S (VE.Norms.backgroundBase (VE.SpeechActs.policy D)) →
                          VE.Norms.Sat S Γ → VE.Formula.denote S [] φ) ∧
              ((∀ (a : VE.Formula), a ∈ Γ → VE.Formula.WellFormed (VE.Norms.envAt (VE.SpeechActs.policy D) 0) [] a) →
                VE.Formula.WellFormed (VE.Norms.envAt (VE.SpeechActs.policy D) 0) [] φ →
                  ∀ (B : VE.Structure),
                    VE.Norms.BaseAdmissible (VE.SpeechActs.policy D) B → VE.Norms.Sat B Γ → VE.Formula.denote B [] φ)
  -- uses VE.Formula.WellFormed@VE.Syntax VE.Formula.denote@VE.Semantics VE.Formula@VE.Syntax VE.Norms.BaseAdmissible@VE.Norms.Prefix VE.Norms.ConflictFree@VE.Norms.Conflict VE.Norms.Doc.T@VE.Norms.Tree VE.Norms.Sat@VE.Norms.Prefix VE.Norms.background@VE.Norms.Prefix VE.Norms.backgroundBase@VE.Norms.Prefix VE.Norms.definitionsHold@VE.Norms.Layer VE.Norms.elaborate@VE.Norms.Elaborate VE.Norms.envAt@VE.Norms.Tree VE.Norms.holdsCatala@VE.Norms.Elaborate VE.Norms.profileHold@VE.Norms.Layer VE.SpeechActs.En@VE.SpeechActs.Tree VE.SpeechActs.SpeechDoc@VE.SpeechActs.Tree VE.SpeechActs.WellFormedSpeech@VE.SpeechActs.Tree VE.SpeechActs.policy@VE.SpeechActs.Tree VE.Structure.Admissible@VE.Semantics VE.Structure.Carrier@VE.Semantics VE.Structure@VE.Semantics VE.Tableau.Certificate@VE.Tableau VE.Tableau.checkCertificate@VE.TableauChecker

theorem VE.Surface.parseStatements_nonempty
  ∀ (E : VE.Environment) (fuel : Nat) (input : List Char),
    input ≠ [] →
      VE.Surface.parseStatements E (fuel + 1) input = do
        let __discr ← VE.Surface.parseRaw E (input.length + 1) [] input
        match __discr with
          | (a, rest) => do
            let rest ← VE.Surface.consume ['.', '\n'] rest
            let tail ← VE.Surface.parseStatements E fuel rest
            Option.some (a :: tail)
  -- uses VE.Environment@VE.Syntax VE.Formula@VE.Syntax VE.Surface.consume@VE.Surface VE.Surface.parseRaw@VE.Surface VE.Surface.parseStatements@VE.Surface VE.Surface.parseStatements_nonempty.match_1@VE.SurfaceProofs

theorem VE.Time.expandFrom_iff
  ∀ (S : VE.Order.Structure) (ρ : VE.Order.Valuation S) (s : String) (body : VE.Order.Formula) (r j : Nat)
    (ws : List S.Carrier),
    1 ≤ r →

theorem VE.Time.findMonth_spec
  ∀ (y r fuel m : Nat),
    1 ≤ m →
      m ≤ 12 →
        VE.Time.daysBeforeMonth y m ≤ r →
          12 ≤ m + fuel →
            1 ≤ VE.Time.findMonth y r fuel m ∧
              VE.Time.findMonth y r fuel m ≤ 12 ∧
                VE.Time.daysBeforeMonth y (VE.Time.findMonth y r fuel m) ≤ r ∧
                  (VE.Time.findMonth y r fuel m = 12 ∨ r < VE.Time.daysBeforeMonth y (VE.Time.findMonth y r fuel m + 1))
  -- uses VE.Time.daysBeforeMonth@VE.Time.Calendar VE.Time.findMonth@VE.Time.Calendar
  -- expr 3112295353
theorem VE.Time.findYear_spec
  ∀ (n fuel y : Nat),
    VE.Time.daysToYear y ≤ n →
      n < VE.Time.daysToYear (y + fuel + 1) →
        VE.Time.daysToYear (VE.Time.findYear n fuel y) ≤ n ∧
          n < VE.Time.daysToYear (VE.Time.findYear n fuel y + 1) ∧ y ≤ VE.Time.findYear n fuel y
  -- uses VE.Time.daysToYear@VE.Time.Calendar VE.Time.findYear@VE.Time.Calendar
  -- expr 3205989958
